data.jd_text:
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global PMO Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role exists to help build and embed a fit\-for\-purpose PMO capability for the Emerging Markets (EM) business, enabling disciplined execution of innovation and portfolio priorities at pace and with quality.
   

  

 As Flora Food Group continues to scale consumer\-led innovation across regions, the Emerging Markets business requires stronger orchestration across Marketing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. The PMO Manager will act as a foundational builder of this capability: setting up robust ways of working, driving executional discipline, and ensuring projects land on time, in full, and with clear accountability.
   

  

 This role is critical to reducing execution risk, improving speed\-to\-market, and freeing up functional leaders to focus on content and decision\-making rather than coordination.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will help establish an Emerging Markets PMO operating/ framework model aligned to global P\&P / PMO standards, while tailored to local business realities.
   

  

 You will bring consistency, transparency and rigor to how innovation and portfolio initiatives are planned, governed and delivered, and act as the single point of truth for execution status, risks and delivery confidence across the EM innovation and portfolio agenda.
   

  

 You will act as the executional backbone for end\-to\-end project \& activity management, by owning the planning and orchestration of priority innovation and portfolio initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional teams’ ownership and accountability to deliver against clear timelines, milestones and decision gates.
   

  

 You will improve delivery confidence, resource visibility and decision quality across the EM portfolio by ensuring high\-quality data, discipline and follow\-through in portfolio \& project management systems. You will act as a role model for execution discipline, pragmatic problem\-solving and collaborative leadership; and you will help to build the EM PMO capability over time, including a small team, templates/tools, playbooks and best practices, as the EM hub scales.
   

  

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**
 You will be
 **accountable for execution and orchestration** 
 , not for project content ownership. Project leadership and strategic direction will remain with the Marketing / Business leads; this role ensures the work lands.
   

  

 You are biased toward action, clarity and simplification — not to add bureaucracy.
   

  

**What Does It Take To Be Successful**
 You combine strong project management fundamentals with the confidence to operate in complex, cross\-functional FMCG environments. You are comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and you bring calm, clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.
   

  

* 5–10\+ years’ experience in project, program or PMO roles within FMCG / CPG or similarly complex environments
* Experience acting as owner of PMO data quality, reporting cadence and execution dashboards in enterprise environments
* Strong systems thinker with the ability to design simple, scalable ways of working, with proven experience setting up or scaling PMO / project management structures
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end innovation, transformation or portfolio initiatives.
* Strong understanding of stage\-gate models, innovation lifecycles and launch readiness
* Confident facilitator and communicator with experience in influencing senior and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Excellent planning, prioritization, execution discipline, high accountability mindset comfortable holding others to commitments and follow\-through for continuous improvement
* Values transparency, pragmatic, solution\-oriented, resilient under pressure and energised by building capability and enabling others to succeed
* Preferred, but not required: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / SAFe certification.


**What’s next?**
**Flora Food Group** 
 is committed to culinary essentials for better food. We believe fewer, better ideas — executed with excellence — are what drive sustainable growth.
   

  

 This is a career\-defining opportunity to work with our high\-impact brands in a high\-energy, high\-accountability environment. If you recognise yourself in this profile, apply and be part of this exciting journey. Apply now at www.florafoodgroup.com.We prefer to receive your application before
 **25th June 2026** 
 .
   

  

 We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.
   

  

*Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.*
*No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.*

data.jd_text:
A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on more than a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $16 billion, employs approximately 48,000 associates and operates in more than 170 countries around the world. The Middle East and Africa Market is one of our highest\-potential growth markets, and we are investing to accelerate that growth through Enterprise AI, data, and digital innovation.
   

  

 As our
 **Enterprise Ai \- Business Engagement Leader** 
**– Middle East Africa** 
 , you will be at the centre of the MEA market leadership team and serve as the senior link between Ecolab’s
 **Enterprise AI** 
 organisation and the Divisions, Functions, and country leaders driving growth across the region. You will fuel the MEA growth agenda with technology and AI\-enabled business outcomes — accountable for the delivery of solutions, from idea to value capture.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Lead the Enterprise AI agenda for one of Ecolab’s highest\-potential international markets
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI, data, and digital solutions that directly accelerate top\-line and margin growth across MEA
* Partner with senior Market, Division, and Function leaders as a trusted commercially aware technology advisor
* Shape technology strategy, investment prioritisation, and value capture inside a $16B global sustainability leader
* Influence Enterprise\-wide AI and digital strategy while owning local growth outcomes
* Build and develop a high\-performing team of business process analysts and digital talent across the region
* Competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and global career mobility within Ecolab


**What You Will Do**
**Strategic Partnership \& Growth Alignment** 
 — Build strong partnering relationships with MEA business and function leaders to understand their growth ambitions, commercial priorities, and operational challenges. Align Ecolab’s Technology strategy with the MEA market growth strategy, leveraging technology, AI, and analytics to unlock new revenue, expand share, and improve customer outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the business divisions and functions.
   

  

**Solutions Accountability** 
 — Own the delivery of value stream solutions for MEA — from demand intake and business case, through design, build, deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Hold global delivery teams, partners, and local stakeholders to outcomes, schedule, cost, and quality; remove blockers; and ensure committed business value is captured and reported.
   

  

**IT Project Portfolio Management** 
 — Bring visibility and prioritisation to the portfolio of Enterprise AI and digital projects supporting MEA business and function activities. In line with global governance processes, establish project priorities, secure resource availability, and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful delivery. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve issues and risks proactively.
   

  

**Digital \& AI Investment Management** 
 — Work with MEA business leaders to determine Enterprise AI and digital investment levels based on growth opportunity, organisational priorities, and budgetary considerations. Provide recommendations on technology investments, cost optimisation, and resource allocation to maximise commercial value and ROI.
   

  

**Business Relationship Management** 
 — Serve as the primary point of contact for MEA business and function leaders on Enterprise AI, data, and digital topics. Drive effective communication, manage expectations, and address systemic issues, escalations, and enhancement requests related to applications, infrastructure, and digital services.
   

  

**Service Delivery Assurance** 
 — Oversee Enterprise AI and Digital service and support processes for the MEA business. Proactively track service levels, drive process improvement, and act as the escalation point for service topics that impact the growth agenda.
   

  

**Demand Intake \& Prioritisation** 
 — Filter and prioritise MEA project requests before the PMO intake process starts. Verify budget exists in the business or Enterprise Ai plan, and confirm business resource readiness. Keep Enterprise AI resources focused on the highest\-value, growth\-aligned work.
   

  

**Governance, Security \& Architecture** 
 — Ensure 100% Security and Enterprise Architecture sign\-off on MEA projects. Drive adoption of standard, secure enterprise platforms that unlock data and AI opportunities at scale and protect the business.
   

  

**Talent \& Team Leadership** 
 — Lead, coach, and develop market\-aligned business process analysts and digital talent. Drive a strong Enterprise AI culture across the MEA team in line with the Ecolab leadership model, managing by influence across the broader Enterprise AI organisation.
   

  

**Position Details**
* Location: Middle East and Africa region (primary hub Dubai)
* Travel: Regional travel across Middle East and Africa; periodic international travel for Enterprise AI and Markets leadership engagements
* Reporting line: Solid\-line to the Global Markets Business Engagement Leader, with close alignment to the MEA Market Head as a member of the MEA market leadership team
* Work model: Full\-time, hybrid


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in IT, Digital, AI/Data, Business Analysis, Programme Management, or a similar leadership role
* Demonstrated accountability and track record for delivery of major technology or digital programmes in a multi\-country, matrixed environment
* Proven business and commercial acumen — experience of partnering with senior business and function leaders, building business cases, and translating technology strategy into measurable growth outcomes
* Experience managing third\-party technology service providers and global delivery partners against outcome\-based commitments
* Strong written and spoken English


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience operating across the Middle East and/or Africa region, including working with local regulatory, cultural, and commercial environments
* Experience leading AI, data, and analytics initiatives that have delivered measurable commercial growth
* Experience in a global manufacturing, B2B services, or industrial environment
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP/ERP, CRM, data and analytics, cloud, and security technologies
* Knowledge of Ecolab’s industries — Institutional, Industrial, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Pest Elimination — is a plus
* Additional regional languages (Arabic, French) a plus
* Master’s degree or equivalent (MBA, MSc) a plus


**Key Skills \& Leadership Behaviours**
* Business and commercial acumen — understands P\&L, growth levers, customer economics, and how technology and AI investments translate into commercial outcomes
* Growth mindset — relentless focus on unlocking new revenue, market share, and productivity through Enterprise AI and digital
* Ownership — drives delivery from idea to adoption to value capture, with no hand\-off gaps
* Leadership presence to motivate and develop diverse, multi\-country teams
* Manage by influence — collaborates across global Enterprise AI groups to develop talent and drive results
* Focus and decisiveness — enables action and progress even when faced with ambiguity
* Executive communication — strong stakeholder management at C\-suite and Market leadership level


*Ecolab is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with a disability.*
**About Enterprise AI At Ecolab**
 Enterprise AI is the technology and intelligence engine behind Ecolab’s global growth — delivering the AI, data, platforms, and digital solutions that help our customers and our 48,000 associates operate cleaner, safer, and more sustainably in more than 170 countries. We combine the agility of an AI\-first organisation with the scale and stability of a Fortune 500 enterprise, partnering closely with every Ecolab Division, Market, and Function to turn data and technology into measurable commercial growth.
   

  

 Join us, and help shape what comes next — for Ecolab, for our customers, and for the planet.
   

  

**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

data.jd_text:
**Your mission**
 We are seeking an experienced and forward\-thinking Project Director to lead the delivery of some of the most ambitious and innovative Spatial Experience projects in the region and beyond. This is not a traditional project management role \- it is a senior leadership position for someone who can drive complex turnkey projects with confidence, precision, and commercial clarity.
   

  

 You will take ownership of a portfolio of high\-profile international projects across museums, visitor attractions, cultural destinations, and large\-scale experiential installations. From tender strategy and planning through execution and close\-out, you will shape delivery standards, elevate performance, and ensure exceptional outcomes for both clients and stakeholders.
   

  

 Operational excellence is essential, but what sets this role apart is leadership. We are looking for a strategic decision\-maker and delivery\-driven leader who can build strong teams, manage complexity at scale, and consistently raise the bar in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment.
   

  

 Key responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead a portfolio of complex international projects from tender stage through planning, execution, delivery, and close\-out, ensuring full project organization and control.
* Oversee the development of the master project schedule and ensure effective implementation across all phases.
* Monitor project performance with a strong focus on quality, deadlines, and cost control.
* Conduct project reviews and produce detailed reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously, from pre\-construction through completion.
* Ensure strict adherence to ethics, compliance, and internal governance requirements at all times.
* Actively participate in the tender process, including design coordination, submission preparation, and tender review.
* Provide leadership in risk assessment, contract negotiations, fee structures, and pricing decisions.
* Tender, negotiate, and award supplier and subcontractor contracts.
* Collaborate with Crew Management on resource planning for assigned projects using EasyJob software.
* Coordinate with QHSE teams on\-site to ensure delivery in line with HSE and QAQC standards and compliance requirements.
* Build and maintain strong long\-term client relationships and actively expand the client network.
* Identify and secure growth opportunities, initiating and supporting new project development.
* Support Project Managers and project teams, proactively resolving escalated issues and ensuring smooth project delivery.


**Your profile**
* Proven experience in project management and delivery of turnkey projects (scenic, fit\-out, AVL) such as museums, visitor experience centers, EXPO pavilions, and other permanent or semi\-permanent installations within the entertainment and cultural sector.
* Degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Audiovisual Engineering, or a related field is highly desirable.
* Solid technical understanding of Audio, Video, Lighting systems, and control technologies, with experience in large\-scale installations (preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to develop, manage, and control large\-scale project budgets.
* Strong industry network within the UAE and KSA is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.
* Flexible and adaptable, with willingness to work according to project and industry requirements.
* Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and contractual interfaces across complex project environments.


**Why us?**
* Unified CAT A Silver Premium Medical Insurance provided as standard to all team members – yes, you read that correctly, we all enjoy the same insurance category benefits!
* Complimentary lunches provided daily in our Dubai office canteen.
* Team Engagement Initiatives – team\-building activities, health and wellness drives, etc.
* Team Socials – team BBQs, season opening and closing parties.
* Worker’s Compensation and Accident Insurance.
* Annual Flight Allowance.
* Recruitment Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful applicants for our open positions.
* Project Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful project leads.
* The opportunity to work in an international and multi\-cultural team with collaboration across our offices in the Middle East and Europe.
* Collaborative and motivated working environment.
* Trusting and partnership\-based cooperation across all units.
* An innovative and growth\-oriented company with a matrix organizational structure and an open corporate culture.


**About Us**
 BeWunder is your turnkey partner specializing in Event Production and Spatial Experiences.
   

  

 We create inspiring and unforgettable experiences for our clients and their guests. Our renowned and highly\-skilled team of industry experts in both live events and permanent construction is well\-versed in bridging the gap between vision and reality. We design, deliver and service complex, challenging, and large\-scale projects in the field of museums and exhibitions, EXPO and brand pavilions, visitor and experience centers, digital art spaces, live events \- both corporate and sporting, as well as conferences and multimedia shows.
   

  

 Our passion lies in producing multisensory and immersive experiences, a perfect blend of new technologies and content, staged lighting and interactive elements.
   

  

 With our international track record in Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we are perfectly positioned to realize exceptional projects for our clients around the globe, from initial concept design through to final installation and beyond!

data.jd_text:
**Job Title:** 
 SVP Head of Digital Channels \| Business Banking
 



**Job Purpose:** 




 We are seeking a strategic and execution\-driven digital leader to oversee the full digital ecosystem for Business Banking. This role owns the digital experience for SME and commercial clients — from digital onboarding and day\-to\-day servicing to platform partnerships, embedded finance, and next\-generation digital channels.
 



 The incumbent will lead multi\-disciplinary squads, shape the digital roadmap, and drive the evolution of our business banking platforms (web, mobile, API, and partner integrations). You will play a pivotal role in transforming how businesses interact with the bank, enhancing operational resilience, and accelerating digital acquisition and revenue growth.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Digital Strategy \& Channel Ownership** 



* Define and lead the end\-to\-end digital strategy for Business Banking across mobile, web, API, and ecosystem channels.
* Develop a multi\-year roadmap that enhances customer experience, drives digital adoption, and positions the bank competitively against fintech and neo\-bank offerings.
* Ensure alignment between digital journeys, product strategy, and business priorities



**2\. Customer Acquisition, Journeys \& Experience** 



* Own the full customer lifecycle across digital onboarding, activation, servicing, and cross\-sell touchpoints.
* Continuously optimise journeys to improve conversion, reduce friction, and enable straight\-through processing.
* Partner with Marketing on digital campaigns that drive acquisition, engagement, and product penetration.



**3\. Data, Insights \& Performance Management** 



* Build comprehensive dashboards and analytics frameworks to track usage, engagement, adoption, drop\-off, and channel performance.
* Use behavioural and transactional insights to guide prioritisation, product enhancements, and commercial decisions.
* Deliver regular reporting to senior leadership on performance, business impact, and future opportunities.



**4\. Operational Resilience \& Channel Reliability** 



* Serve as the business owner and escalation point for digital channel issues, ensuring swift triage, stakeholder communication, and resolution.
* Strengthen incident management processes and ensure alignment with IT, Architecture, Governance, and Cyber Security.
* Maintain high standards of availability, security, and regulatory compliance.



**5\. Product Delivery, Technology Collaboration \& Agile Leadership** 



* Lead cross\-functional product squads responsible for delivering new capabilities across onboarding, servicing, payments, lending, and ecosystem integrations.
* Prioritise the backlog based on customer value, commercial impact, and strategic objectives.
* Work closely with Technology, Architecture, QA, Infrastructure, and third\-party partners to deliver scalable and stable solutions.



**6\. Ecosystem, Embedded Finance \& API Expansion** 



* Build and scale new\-age business models through BaaS, Open Banking, embedded finance, and partner platforms.
* Drive API\-based integrations with accounting systems, HRMS solutions, fintech partners, and marketplaces.
* Identify opportunities to extend digital reach beyond traditional channels.



**7\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Champion digital\-first thinking, emerging technologies, automation, AI\-driven experiences, and cloud adoption.
* Introduce best practices from global SME digital banking, challenger banks, and fintech ecosystems.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, customer\-centricity, and rapid delivery.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.
* 15\+ years in digital banking, SME banking, fintech, or digital product management, with at least 5 years in senior leadership.
* Proven experience owning digital channels, digital onboarding, or SME/Business Banking platforms.
* Strong understanding of data analytics, customer experience design, and agile delivery models.
* Exposure to API banking, embedded finance, BaaS, or ecosystem integrations is a strong advantage.

data.jd_text:
**Your new company** 




  





 We are working with a cutting\-edge, research\-driven FinTech company backed by a prominent family office. Specializing in advanced, AI\-powered investment and allocation strategies, they combine mathematical modeling, portfolio optimization, and risk analytics to build a sophisticated SaaS platform.
 



 As they scale their elite, Dubai\-based AI engineering hub, they are seeking a structured, hands\-on Head of Delivery to serve as the operational anchor of the team.
 



  





  





**Your new role** 




 As the Head of Delivery, you will act as the critical bridge between people, tech, and product. Sitting between senior management (the Group CFO and Director) and a highly talented technical team, you will be the operational backbone of the Dubai office.
 



 Your core responsibilities will include:
 


* **Owning Delivery:** 
 Chairing and leading recurring progress ("J\-curve") meetings, tracking technical commitments relentlessly, and following up through to execution.
* **Team Coordination:** 
 Coordinating a small, senior team of engineers and support staff, ensuring clear alignment between leadership and technical execution.
* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** 
 Leading the hiring lifecycle for top\-tier technical and AI talent—screening, interviewing, and making clear hire/no\-hire recommendations.
* **Strategy \& Product Documentation:** 
 Turning rough internal directions into clear, exceptionally well\-written documentation and positioning pieces for internal and external stakeholders.



  





  





**What you'll need to succeed** 




 You do not need to be an engineer yourself, but you must be a masterful, structured coordinator who is highly comfortable working alongside technical minds.
 



 To be successful, you will need:
 


* Proven experience in a delivery, operations, or program management role within a technology, software, or AI environment.
* Deep hands\-on experience and working knowledge of
 **Kanban and Scrum** 
 frameworks.
* Excellent technical literacy—the ability to understand engineering workflows, ask the right questions, and hold people to their commitments.
* A solid understanding of the
 **finance industry, financial markets, or private equity** 
 (highly advantageous).
* Strong recruitment instincts with a confident ability to assess and judge technical candidates.
* Impeccable written and spoken English, paired with a calm, diplomatic, and self\-directed personal style.
* A commitment to being based full\-time, on\-site in Dubai.



  





  





**What you'll get in return** 




  





 This is a unique opportunity to join a highly specialized, well\-backed entity at an exciting stage of product innovation. You will receive a highly competitive compensation package tailored to your experience. For the right international candidate looking to make a long\-term commitment to Dubai, comprehensive relocation support is available.
 



  





  





**What you'll need to do now** 




 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up\-to\-date copy of your CV, and a consultant will reach out to you should your profile look suitable, for a further discussion.

data.jd_text:
**Why qlub**
 The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.
   

  

 From Pay\-at\-Table and Digital Menus to Order\-and\-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.
   

  

 We're a fast\-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e\& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.
   

  

**The role**
 qlub is scaling fast across markets worldwide, and we look for people who take real ownership of their work. As our next Operations Executive, you'll help drive our growth in Partner Success building, shipping, and delivering results from day one.
   

  

 You'll work closely with operators and partners to turn frictionless payments into real growth for restaurants. You'll also play a key role in ensuring new restaurant partners have a smooth onboarding journey and that existing partners maximize their adoption of Qlub solutions. From training restaurant staff to troubleshooting issues and driving re\-engagement, you'll be at the frontlines of ensuring our partners and their customers have the best possible experience.
   

  

 If you thrive in a fast\-moving, build\-from\-scratch environment, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Onboarding \& Setup**
* Support the full onboarding journey of new restaurant partners, including account setup and system configurations when required
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Tech, Content, Procurement, and Account Management, to ensure a seamless go\-live experience
* Ensure all onboarding activities are completed accurately and on time to facilitate successful launches


**Training \& Enablement**
* Conduct in\-person and remote training sessions for restaurant staff to ensure smooth adoption of Qlub's solutions
* Organize and deliver retraining sessions when needed to address knowledge gaps and reinforce best practices
* Act as a trusted advisor for restaurant teams, helping them maximize the value of Qlub's products and features


**Performance Monitoring \& Adoption**
* Monitor partner performance metrics, including QR adoption rates and transaction trends, to proactively identify opportunities and potential issues
* Troubleshoot operational and technical challenges in collaboration with Account Management, Customer Support, and Tech teams
* Implement corrective actions and provide ongoing enablement to drive long\-term adoption and engagement
* Conduct regular restaurant visits and operational checks to ensure teams remain confident and effective in using Qlub solutions


**Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Feedback**
* Partner closely with Account Managers to share insights on partner performance and ensure timely communication with key stakeholders
* Gather feedback from restaurant partners and frontline staff to continuously improve processes, training materials, and the overall partner experience
* Collaborate with Product, Operations, and Tech teams to identify recurring challenges and contribute to scalable solutions and product enhancements


**What You’ll Own**
* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new restaurant partners, ensuring a seamless setup experience and building strong partner relationships from day one
* Drive adoption and engagement for newly onboarded partners, achieving and maintaining a target Qlub adoption rate of 45% across assigned accounts
* Monitor and manage the performance of existing partner outlets, proactively identifying opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and overall partner success


**Who You Are**
* You've done this before in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment
* You move fast and make strong decisions with incomplete information
* You take real ownership and think like an operator, not a coordinator
* You're energized by solving problems and creating exceptional experiences for restaurant partners and their customers
* You're highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail
* You enjoy working directly with customers, building relationships, and helping partners succeed


**What You'll Need**
* A valid driving license and access to a car are required
* 0–2 years of experience in customer onboarding, account management, training, customer success, or a similar client\-facing role
* Proven ability to deliver training sessions and engage diverse audiences effectively
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to troubleshoot issues and coordinate solutions quickly across multiple stakeholders
* Proficiency with digital tools such as CRM systems, Google Workspace, Excel, and Google Sheets
* Fluency in English is a must
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment where priorities can shift quickly


**Nice to have**
* Experience in hospitality, F\&B, SaaS, or technology environments is a strong plus
* Fluency in Arabic is a plus


**What We Offer**
* Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
* The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
* A fast\-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
* Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
* A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest\-growing restaurant technology companies globally


**Ready to build?** 
 Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

**Role Description** 




 The Regional Director – Middle East \& French West Africa will lead the establishment, expansion, and long‑term development of the company’s pharmaceutical business across the Middle East Region and Francophone West Africa. The role carries full regional P\&L responsibility and is accountable for building a scalable commercial platform capable of delivering sustainable growth across multiple markets.
 



  





 The regional expansion strategy will initially focus on establishing a strong presence in Iraq, Senegal, and Ivory Coast, followed by expansion into selected non\-GCC Middle Eastern markets and key Frontier and West African (FWA) markets. Subsequently, the strategy will extend to GCC countries to further strengthen the company's regional footprint.
 



  





 This position represents a senior regional leadership role responsible for developing the company’s commercial footprint, building high‑performing country teams, establishing strong distributor and stakeholder relationships and delivering consistent financial and operational performance across the region.
 



  





 The successful candidate will combine strong strategic leadership with hands‑on execution capability and an entrepreneurial mindset suited to building a regional business in the region.
 



  





**Governance and Reporting Structure** 




 The Regional Director will report to the Group Director International Business and will be responsible for overall governance, operational leadership, and financial performance of the defined region.
 



 Key governance responsibilities include:
 


* Full regional profit and loss accountability
* Development and execution of regional business plans
* Establishment of effective governance and reporting processes
* Alignment of regional strategy with global corporate objectives
* Ensuring regulatory, financial, and operational compliance across all markets



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Regional Strategy Development** 



* Develop and implement the commercial strategy for the region.
* Identify and prioritize new market entry opportunities including new countries, therapeutic segments, market segments, and product opportunities.
* Develop multi‑year regional growth plans including revenue targets, portfolio expansion, and market penetration strategies.
* Assess regulatory environments and competitive landscapes across the region.



  





**Market Entry and Expansion** 



* Lead the planning and execution of country launches across priority markets.
* Establish commercial operations in new markets including distributor and promotional agency partnerships, commercial infrastructure, and local teams.
* Expand operations beyond the initial markets of Iraq, Senegal and Ivory Coast, into other regional markets.
* Drive early market entry and rapid product launch strategies.



  





**Regulatory and Market Access Acceleration** 



* Assess regulatory environments across target markets.
* Devise and implement strategies and action plans to accelerate regulatory processes.
* Ensure early market entry and rapid new product launches through proactive regulatory planning and coordination.



  





**Commercial Leadership** 



* Provide strategic and operational leadership to commercial teams across the region.
* Establish clear regional sales targets and financial performance expectations.
* Drive revenue growth and market share expansion across multiple markets.
* Ensure disciplined commercial execution at the country and front\-line levels.



  





**Organization and Team Development** 



* Recruit, develop, and lead strong country leadership and front\-line teams.
* Foster a culture of engagement, accountability, and performance across all country teams.
* Drive continuous team development and capability building.
* Promote strong collaboration across commercial, regulatory, and operational functions.



  





**Operational Leadership and Execution** 



* Maintain a hands‑on leadership approach with active involvement in on‑ground execution.
* Ensure disciplined implementation of commercial plans and market expansion initiatives.
* Work closely with distributors and local partners to ensure strong market penetration.
* Closely engage with key opinion leaders and key officers of major medical associations in the region and at the county level.



  





**Business Monitoring and Performance Management** 



* Develop and implement robust business monitoring systems across the region.
* Establish performance management frameworks to track sales, profitability, and operational metrics.
* Monitor business performance against plans and forecasts.
* Implement corrective actions where deviations from plan occur.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting systems at country, region and corporate levels.



  





**Strategic Partnerships and Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Build strong relationships with pharmaceutical distributors and channel partners across the region.
* Engage regulatory authorities and healthcare stakeholders across the region.
* Represent the company within relevant pharmaceutical and healthcare industry forums.
* Identify partnerships that accelerate market penetration and commercial growth.



  





**Cross‑Functional Leadership** 



* Coordinate regional activities across regulatory, supply chain, marketing, finance, and medical functions.
* Ensure alignment between regional commercial strategy and corporate priorities.
* Maintain strong operational discipline and compliance across all markets.



  





**Performance Expectations** 




 Success in the role will be measured by the candidate’s ability to:
 


* Deliver strong regional revenue growth and profitability
* Successfully launch and expand operations across priority markets
* Build high‑performing country leadership teams
* Establish a scalable commercial infrastructure across the Middle East and Francophone West Africa
* Achieve rapid market penetration and successful product launches
* Implement strong governance, reporting, and business monitoring systems



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate must have:
 


* More than 15 years of pharmaceutical commercial leadership experience, including at least 5 years in sales leadership positions
* Significant experience managing multi‑country operations in Africa
* Strong knowledge of Middle East and African healthcare markets
* Demonstrated success launching or expanding pharmaceutical businesses in emerging markets
* Strong financial and P\&L management capability

**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Director of Project Execution** 
 who will
 **report directly to the Executive Management** 
 and oversee multiple airport BHS and MHS projects. You will provide guidance and leadership to the Project Execution and Site Management teams, foster collaboration across internal functions and external stakeholders, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on\-time, on\-budget, contract compliant, and to the required quality through to handover.
   

  

**What are my responsibilities?**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of airport BHS/MHS programs, ensuring safe, on\-budget, contract\-compliant execution.
* Serve as senior client and stakeholder lead, aligning airport authorities/operators, consultants/PMCs, contractors, and internal teams.
* Own the full lifecycle from engineering coordination through installation, integration, testing, commissioning, ORAT, and handover to Service.
* Drive strong project governance (steerco, reviews, workshops), ensuring clear decisions, actions, and follow\-up.
* Manage portfolio performance across multi\-site/multi\-country matrix teams; control KPIs, risk, change, and escalations, including recovery/turnaround.
* Ensure effective site execution in live airport environments, including M\&E installation, upgrades, brownfield works, and system interface management.
* Ensure completeness and quality of technical/contract documentation and reporting across the project lifecycle.
* Lead successful handovers to Life\-Cycle Services, ensuring continuity, training, spares, warranty transition, and sign\-off.
* Support Sales \& Bid activities to develop opportunities and ensure executable delivery strategies and resourcing inputs.
* Build and lead high\-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and continuous improvement.


**What do I need to qualify for the role?**
* 10\+ years delivering complex engineering/automation/site projects; strong ownership of cost, schedule, quality, and safety.
* Proven leadership in multi\-stakeholder environments with strong client\-facing and executive communication capability.
* Strong experience in airport BHS or MHS systems including site execution and commissioning; ORAT exposure is a plus.
* Solid understanding of automation integration environments (mechanical/electrical, PLC/SCADA/controls, interfaces).
* Strong commercial and contractual discipline: change control, risk/opportunity management, claims awareness.
* Proficient in project tools (e.g., MS Project/Primavera, MS Office; Jira/Confluence is a plus).
* Willingness to travel and operate in dynamic airport environments.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

* About Arada


 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Act as the central operational link and technical attaché to the Project Controls Director, driving portfolio\-wide data consolidation, cross\-functional stakeholder coordination, and executive reporting from the Head Office. This role is responsible for standardizing reporting frameworks across all high\-rise and master development sites, monitoring design and procurement trackers, and developing C\-suite presentations, serving as the strategic right\-hand support for all departmental operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Portfolio Data Consolidation \& Reporting Governance
* Central Database Management: Establish and maintain the department's central project controls database, ensuring seamless data harvesting and consolidation from all project sites.
* Reporting Standardization: Design, implement, and enforce standardized weekly and monthly reporting templates across contractors, consultants, and internal project teams to ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency.
* Periodic Audit \& Review: Conduct rigorous reviews of incoming site reports, cross\-verifying contractor progress claims against actual site conditions and flagging critical path anomalies, schedule risks, and reporting inconsistencies directly to the Project Controls Director.
* Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Coordination (Pre\-Contract Tracks)
* Design \& Procurement Tracking: Establish, manage, and continuously update comprehensive trackers and dashboards for pre\-construction activities, with a strong focus on design development, authority approvals, procurement milestones, and package award schedules.
* Internal Stakeholder Interface: Coordinate directly with Development Managers, Design Directors, and Procurement leads to resolve scheduling conflicts and ensure pre\-contract deliverables align with planned construction commencement dates.
* Master Program Development: Support the Project Controls Director in developing, maintaining, and logic\-linking portfolio\-level master programs that integrate design, permitting, tendering, procurement, and construction activities.
* Executive Analytics \& C\-Suite Presentations
* Dashboard Management: Maintain and oversee the department’s live Power BI and ERP\-based dashboards, transforming complex project, commercial, and schedule data into meaningful performance indicators and executive\-level insights.
* Executive Presentation Development: Consolidate portfolio\-wide progress updates, schedule risks, delay exposures, and cost\-related insights into professional, structured presentations and briefing materials for the CDO, CFO, CEO, and Executive Leadership Team.
* Special Briefings \& Ad\-Hoc Analytics: Act as an operational extension of the Project Controls Director by conducting deep\-dive analyses, forensic schedule reviews, and focused data audits on critical or distressed project packages as required.
* Site\-HO Bridging \& Compliance Enforcement
* Site Coordination: Maintain close engagement with embedded site planning teams, consultants, and contractors to ensure real\-time visibility of progress, risks, and emerging critical path delays.
* Process Enforcement: Audit planning and reporting compliance across all projects, ensuring schedule networks, baseline updates, milestone reporting, and delay notifications adhere strictly to Arada’s Project Controls Manual and governance requirements.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* PMP or PMI\-SP (Scheduling Professional) certifications are highly advantageous.


**Experience**
* 7–10 years of progressive project planning and scheduling experience within the UAE real estate, developer, or construction sector.
* A balanced background is essential, including:
+ Minimum 3–4 years of hands\-on site\-based construction planning and execution experience.
+ Minimum 3–4 years within a Head Office PMO, Project Controls, or Developer corporate environment.

* Proven experience supporting multiple projects simultaneously and coordinating across diverse stakeholder groups.


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced to expert\-level proficiency in Primavera P6\.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel reporting and analytical capabilities.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and data visualization skills.
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation design with the ability to prepare executive\-level reporting materials.
* Strong understanding of project controls methodologies, schedule governance, and portfolio reporting frameworks.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organizational agility.
* Ability to confidently engage with senior leadership while maintaining strong technical credibility with consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Strong analytical mindset with the capability to challenge assumptions, identify reporting inconsistencies, and provide data\-driven recommendations.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of operating effectively in a fast\-paced, multi\-project environment.

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 Müller's Solutions is looking for a senior, hands\-on Project Manager to lead the delivery of a SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation for a major trading group based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will take full ownership of a multi\-legal\-entity Finance and Supply Chain transformation — from Fit\-to\-Standard workshops through go\-live and hypercare — working at the intersection of our client's leadership and a hybrid onsite/offshore delivery team.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role within our Middle East practice. You will report directly to the Managing Director and act as the single point of accountability for scope, schedule, budget, and client satisfaction throughout the engagement.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 — End\-to\-end delivery of the S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition program using SAP ACTIVATE methodology, from Prepare through Run.
   

  

 — A delivery team spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Integration, Data Migration, and Training — coordinating onsite and offshore workstreams as one team.
   

  

 — The project plan, RAID log, budget tracking, and resourcing decisions across all phases.
   

  

 — Executive\-level reporting and steering committee facilitation with client leadership across 4 legal entities.
   

  

 — Scope governance and change request management, protecting both project quality and commercial margin.
   

  

 — Cutover planning, go\-live readiness, and hypercare oversight — ensuring the client lands the system successfully.
   

  

 — Coordination of ZATCA Phase 2 compliance milestones with the Finance workstream lead.
   

  

**Requirements**
 — 8\+ years of SAP project management experience, with full lifecycle accountability.
   

  

 — A minimum of 3 completed SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition go\-lives as lead Project Manager.
   

  

 — SAP ACTIVATE methodology certification.
   

  

 — Demonstrated experience managing multi\-legal\-entity SAP deployments within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 — Confident, polished stakeholder management with C\-level and finance leadership in Arabic\-speaking business environments.
   

  

 — A track record of holding scope, budget, and timeline discipline on fixed\-price or milestone\-based engagements.
   

  

**Preferred**
 — PMP or PRINCE2 certification.
   

  

 — Prior experience in trading, distribution, or manufacturing client environments.
   

  

 — Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite and BTP\-based integration landscapes.
   

  

**Benefits**
 — Work on flagship Cloud ERP transformations for some of the region's most respected enterprises, backed by a multi\-vendor partner ecosystem spanning SAP, ServiceNow, OpenText, BMC, Boomi, and Red Hat.
   

  

 — A Berlin\-headquartered firm with genuine regional depth — offices in Riyadh, Dubai, Cairo, and Casablanca, and an offshore delivery model that lets you focus on what matters most: the client.
   

  

 — Direct visibility and access to senior leadership — your impact on client outcomes is seen and valued, not buried in a large delivery hierarchy.
   

  

 — A culture that rewards ownership: you scope it, you lead it, you're credited for it.

**Description**
 About Amazon:
   

  

 Amazon is a global e\-commerce and cloud computing company guided by four principles: customer obsession rather than competitor focus, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long\-term thinking. We strive to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company, Earth’s best employer, and Earth’s safest place to work.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and Technical Program Manager to drive innovation and optimization within AMET, leveraging the power of Amazon Web Services (AWS) . This role will be instrumental in identifying, developing and implementing solutions that improve efficiency, improve results, reduce costs, and enhance the overall customer experience. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading complex projects and a passion for leveraging AWS, including AI/ML services, to solve challenging problems. This role will require strong leadership, technical acumen and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategy Development: Develop and execute a comprehensive automation strategy aligned with Amazon's overall goals, focusing on AWS Solutions. This includes identifying key areas for prioritizing projects and defining measurable success metrics.
* Project Leadership: Lead the full lifecycle of AWS\-powered projects, from ideation and requirements gathering to implementation and post\-launch support. This includes managing project timelines, budgets, resources and risks.
* AWS Technology Evaluation: Research and evaluate relevant AWS technologies, including AI/ML services like Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Comprehend, Amazon Rekognition, and other relevant solutions like AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, and Amazon EC2\. Identify and recommend the best AWS services to meet our specific needs.
* Solution Design: Collaborate with engineering, operations and other stakeholders to design and develop innovative automation solutions. This includes defining functional requirements, developing technical specifications and overseeing the integration of new systems within the AWS ecosystem.
* Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across the organization. Communicate project updates effectively and ensure alignment on goals and objectives.
* Team Leadership: Mentor and develop automation capability. Provide guidance, support, and opportunities for growth, fostering expertise in AWS and SCOT technologies.
* Continuous Improvement: Monitor the performance of implemented solutions and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Implement changes to optimize efficiency and effectiveness, leveraging analytics tools.
* Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external stakeholders, particularly those specializing in AWS integrations. Negotiate contracts and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality products.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Proven track record of leading and implementing complex automation projects.
* Experience with AWS cloud computing platform and its core services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda).
* Excellent project management skills, including the ability to manage timelines, budgets, and resources.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Experience with data analytics and visualization tools, particularly within the AWS ecosystem (e.g., Amazon QuickSight).
* Experience with AWS AI/ML services (e.g., Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Comprehend, Amazon Rekognition).
* AWS Certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Machine Learning \- Specialty).


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The Senior Technical Program Manager will have the following responsibilities
   

  

* Drive Automation/AI solutions through a sprint mechanism. These ideas should produce savings in hours or cost.
* Deliver Annual roadmap for complex projects that solves important challenges.
* Build AI/Automation capabilities to increase the base of the core team support and scale the program deliverables.
* Maintain program dashboard and P0
* Produce Monthly Program Update.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

* Defined work packages

* Downstream systems

 • Act as the primary coordinator for all integrations

* Event contracts
* Data payload structures

* Missing or incomplete data fields

* Channel\-level consent mapping

 • Identify and manage cross\-system dependencies early:
 


* Source systems

* Risk log
* Dependency tracker
* Decision log

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

**About PFM**
 Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast\-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff. Whether you're a trader, technologist, marketer, or operator \- your work here shapes how thousands of users find and trust prop firms.
   

  

**About The Department**
 UAE Operations \& Regulatory Affairs sits at the intersection of Finance, Legal, and Operations. It owns the integrity of PFM's UAE\-based entity (Prop Firm Match Global FZCO) — governance, free\-zone compliance, banking, tax, audit, visa sponsorship, and regulator\-facing relationships. Our current priority is professionalising the local operating layer so the business can scale internationally without regulatory or operational drag.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Own everything PFM does in the UAE — entity governance, regulatory standing, banking and tax compliance, audit readiness, free\-zone licensing, visa sponsorship, and relationships with local authorities and service providers. Be the senior PFM presence on the ground in the UAE and the trusted commercial\-regulatory bridge between leadership and the UAE ecosystem.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Performance objectives**
**Objective 1 \- Own UAE entity governance and free\-zone compliance**
 Outcome: Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is fully compliant, in good standing, and audit\-ready at all times.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Maintain free\-zone licence, share capital, and corporate documentation up to date
* Ensure timely renewals, statutory filings, and entity\-level reporting
* Coordinate with the free\-zone authority on all governance matters
* Run quarterly governance reviews with the CFO


**Objective 2 \- Lead regulatory affairs and authority relationships**
 Outcome: PFM operates with regulatory clarity in the UAE and can navigate questions from authorities quickly and credibly.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Own the regulatory map for PFM's activities in the UAE (free\-zone, federal, financial\-services adjacencies)
* Build and maintain relationships with regulators, free\-zone authorities, banks, and key service providers
* Track regulatory changes affecting PFM and translate them into business impact and action items
* Lead any direct regulator engagement or audit on PFM's behalf, in coordination with legal counsel
* Partner with internal and external legal counsel on the UAE legal landscape — contracts, employment law, FZCO governance, commercial agreements, and dispute resolution


**Objective 3 \- Manage UAE operations: banking, tax, audit, and admin**
 Outcome: All UAE\-side operational rails (banking, corporate tax, VAT, audit, visas, office, vendors) run smoothly with no surprises.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Manage banking relationships and resolve account\-, transaction\-, or compliance\-related issues
* Oversee UAE corporate tax (9%) and VAT registration, filings, and compliance with the Federal Tax Authority
* Lead the annual statutory audit cycle in coordination with the Finance function
* Sponsor visas for UAE\-based hires and manage related immigration, residency, and renewal workflows
* Own the UAE office presence (if applicable), vendor contracts, insurance, and local administration


**Objective 4 \- Partner with leadership on UAE strategic initiatives**
 Outcome: Leadership has a trusted UAE partner who can scope, scale, and de\-risk any new initiative anchored in the region.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Advise leadership on the regulatory and operational implications of new products, partnerships, or markets
* Lead UAE\-specific initiatives such as banking expansion, new entity structures, or regulatory licensing
* Represent PFM in select UAE industry forums and at high\-trust meetings with partners or authorities
* Surface risks and opportunities to the CFO and CEO with clear written analysis


**What We Look For**
**Must have**
* 7\+ years of operations, regulatory, or compliance leadership experience in the UAE
* Hands\-on familiarity with one or more UAE free zones (e.g., DMCC, IFZA, DIFC, ADGM, JAFZA)
* Strong working knowledge of UAE corporate tax, VAT, and Federal Tax Authority requirements
* Experience managing banking relationships and resolving compliance / KYC matters with UAE banks
* Track record of running statutory audits and filings end\-to\-end
* Demonstrated experience working with internal or external legal counsel on UAE\-specific matters — contracts, employment law, free\-zone governance, or commercial agreements
* Excellent English; comfortable operating in a remote\-first, async\-first environment

data.jd_text:
**Posted on the Senna Private Equity Careers Network.**
**Overview**
 This Senior Project Manager role is based in Dubai, UAE, and sits within the project management function of a real estate company. The position carries direct accountability for the end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-disciplined real estate projects on behalf of clients, spanning planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout. The successful candidate will lead experienced project teams, manage complex stakeholder relationships, and ensure that budget, schedule, quality, and risk objectives are met across each engagement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage all facets of project management — budget, schedule, procurement, quality, and risk — across individual real estate projects from inception through closeout.
* Interface directly with clients to define project requirements; prepare scope of work, resource plans, cost estimates, budgets, cash flow projections, work plan schedules, milestones, quality controls, and risk registers.
* Read, interpret, and apply standards to complex project documents including contracts, agreements, leases, work letters, project charters, surveys, and architectural drawings.
* Identify and qualify project delivery resources; conduct requests for proposals, lead bid analysis, facilitate evaluation interviews, and recommend appointments to clients.
* Lead and provide direction to multi\-disciplined project delivery teams, guiding them toward defined project goals.
* Implement and maintain a structured communication plan, including regular meetings, written reports, and meeting minutes, to keep clients and project teams consistently informed.
* Ensure project documentation governance aligns with company and client requirements; maintain data integrity, accuracy, and timely coordination of all project records.
* Track project progress against approved goals, budgets, and timelines; report on status and variances; develop and execute action plans to address deviations.
* Manage change control processes — assess change requests, evaluate impacts on scope, budget, schedule, quality, and risk, secure client approvals, and issue change orders accordingly.
* Identify complex project risks, lead constructability reviews, and develop and implement risk mitigation and contingency plans.
* Apply understanding of business context — including business cases, economic implications, and risk — to project management decisions.
* Analyse inputs from the wider team and make recommendations with direct impact on project and business outcomes.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree (BA, BS, BEng, or BArch) in a technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Minimum of five years of directly relevant experience in the UAE.
* Demonstrated prior experience managing multi\-disciplined project teams in a similar senior role.
* PMP certification is required.
* MRICS designation is preferred.
* Full professional fluency in English, both written and verbal; Arabic or additional languages are advantageous.
* Valid UAE driver's licence.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings.
* Working knowledge of MS Project, lease structures, construction contracts, and construction practices.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills; ability to solve complex problems and evaluate multiple options in ambiguous situations.
* Ability to comprehend, analyse, and interpret complex business and contractual documents.
* In\-depth knowledge of financial terms and principles; ability to forecast, prepare, and manage budgets and conduct financial analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce reports and deliver persuasive presentations to senior stakeholders and client groups.
* Proven ability to motivate, influence, and negotiate effectively with key team members, senior management, and clients.


 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

* Direct client\-facing accountability on complex, high\-value real estate projects across the UAE market.
* Opportunity to lead experienced, multi\-disciplined teams on projects spanning the full real estate lifecycle.
* A full\-time, permanent position within a structured and established real estate company operating in one of the world's most active real estate markets.


 Application Process
   

  

 This role was posted on 22 June 2026 with Job ID 282466\. Interested candidates should ensure they meet the mandatory PMP certification requirement and the minimum five years of UAE\-based experience before applying. Applications should be submitted through the relevant posting channel associated with this reference.
   

  

**About Senna**
 Senna is a careers platform for professionals pursuing opportunities in private equity. The platform brings together relevant roles, market context, and hiring signals to help candidates navigate the market with greater clarity. For more information, visit joinsenna.com.

data.jd_text:
Role : Director\- Delivery \& Installation Operations
 



 Location: Dubai, UAE
 



  





 This role exists to industrialize delivery and installation operations by introducing scalable operational systems, process discipline, and advanced last\-mile execution methodologies into a high\-volume, concurrent project environment. The position does not replace existing technical expertise — it complements it by building the operational architecture, governance, and scalability layer the business requires for its next phase of growth.
 



  





 The organization currently operates approximately 25 active customer projects per day across varying project sizes, product categories, installation durations, site conditions, and customer expectations. The environment has transitioned from a linear model to a dynamic operational network requiring:
 



 • Concurrent multi\-site project management
 



 • Daily resource reallocation and scheduling
 



 • Continuous customer communication at scale
 



 • Real\-time operational dependency management
 



 • Structured escalation and SLA\-based execution
 



  





 The core challenge is not technical installation knowledge — the organization possesses strong field execution capability. The gap is the absence of advanced process\-driven operational leadership capable of transforming fragmented execution into a scalable, predictable, and systemized operational engine.
 



  





 1\. Operational Architecture \& Process Design
 



 • Design, document, and implement end\-to\-end operational workflows covering scheduling, dispatch, installation sequencing, and project closure
 



 • Standardize all field execution processes across crew types, project categories, and site conditions
 



 • Build and maintain operational SOPs, handover protocols, and quality checkpoints
 



 • Transition the department from reactive firefighting to a structured, repeatable execution model
 



 2\. Multi\-Project Scheduling \& Dispatch Optimization
 



 • Own the daily and weekly scheduling function for all active installation and delivery projects
 



 • Implement dispatch optimization logic to maximize crew utilization and minimize idle time
 



 • Develop priority sequencing models that account for site readiness, product availability, and customer commitments
 



 • Manage resource conflicts and reallocate teams dynamically in response to live operational changes
 



 3\. Operational Control Tower
 



 • Establish and operate a live control tower function providing real\-time visibility into all active projects
 



 • Define and monitor key operational KPIs: on\-time completion rate, revisit rate, crew utilisation, SLA adherence, and delay frequency
 



 • Build dashboards and reporting structures for daily operational review and senior management reporting
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks early and drive structured resolution
 



 4\. Workforce Coordination \& Utilisation
 



 • Manage crew capacity planning, deployment, and productivity tracking
 



 • Coordinate with HR on workforce resourcing, shift planning, and contractor management
 



 • Develop performance frameworks for field teams aligned to operational KPIs
 



 • Reduce overdependence on key individuals by building cross\-trained, interchangeable crew structures
 



 5\. Customer Coordination \& SLA Management
 



 • Define and enforce SLA frameworks covering installation lead times, communication standards, and escalation thresholds
 



 • Work with customer\-facing teams to align operational capacity with customer commitments
 



 • Build structured customer coordination protocols for pre\-installation, day\-of, and post\-installation touchpoints
 



 • Own escalation handling for time\-sensitive or complex customer situations
 



 6\. Technology \& Systems Integration
 



 • Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of operational management technology (scheduling tools, field service management platforms, and dispatch systems)
 



 • Work with IT to integrate operational systems with ERP, CRM, and customer portals
 



 • Drive adoption of digital tools across field teams to improve real\-time communication and job visibility
 



 7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 • Act as the primary operational interface between the installation department, sales, logistics, procurement, and customer experience teams
 



 • Align project execution timelines with product availability, warehouse readiness, and client schedules
 



 • Participate in strategic planning discussions to translate business growth targets into operational capacity requirements
 



  





 8\. Leadership \& Culture
 



 • Build and mentor a high\-performance operational leadership team within the department
 



 • Establish a culture of accountability, process discipline, and continuous improvement

data.raw_snippet: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring.
