data.jd_text:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 By concentrating on healthcare’s toughest challenges, we’ve been able to make many major breakthroughs, improving lives around the world. But there’s still work to be done.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Patient Journey Partner (PJP) to join our team.
   

  

 The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society \- from mostly offering world\-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.
   

  

 The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co\-create meaningful solutions.
   

  

 This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)
   

  

 It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives
   

  

**Your Impact**
 The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey
   

  

* The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem
* Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non\-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster
* Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community
* Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner
* By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co\-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem
* The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs
* Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services


**Who You Are**
* You possess a university degree in a scientific, economic, or business field; an advanced degree in life sciences or an MBA is a plus
* You have a proven track record in leading cross\-functional teams, formulating strategies, and orchestrating execution, with experience partnering with patient advocacy groups (PAGs) being highly desirable
* You demonstrate strong business expertise, particularly in commercialization, medical affairs, and customer experience excellence, and have experience with agile ways of working
* You excel in stakeholder engagement, including partnering with therapeutic area experts (TAEs) and organizations, with excellent collaboration and communication skills
* You possess deep knowledge of patient journeys and treatments in defined disease areas, enabling meaningful engagement with specialists and external stakeholders
* You are skilled at leveraging digital tools and innovation methodologies to enhance outcomes and create scalable value
* You demonstrate a growth mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and a commitment to acting with integrity while navigating complexity and making bold, value\-driven decisions
* You are fluent in the local language and proficient in English, enabling seamless collaboration across the Roche global enterprise


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

 LEADERSHIP

data.jd_text:
**Project Overview** 




 The Taweelah C Project is a landmark greenfield development in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, representing one of the region's most advanced and efficient combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) power plants. With an installed capacity of approximately 2\.6 GW, the project will play a critical role in supporting the UAE's growing electricity demand while delivering high efficiency and lower emissions through state\-of\-the\-art technology.
 



 The project brings together leading international partners with Al Jomaih Energy and Water Co. Ltd. (AEW) and Sembcorp Utilities Pte. Ltd. (Sembcorp) together with TAQA acting as the Project Company
 



 Taweelah C offers a unique opportunity to be part of a high\-profile infrastructure project that will set new benchmarks in performance, reliability, and sustainability in the region's power sector.
   





**Location:** 
 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is 30 to 40 Kms from Abu Dhabi city)
 



**Duration:** 
 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 To lead and oversee all construction activities for the Taweelah C Power Project. Ensuring the timely, on\-budget, and quality delivery of the asset, meeting contractual requirements, and design specifications for reliable and sustainable operation over the Power Purchase Agreement period.
 



 Implementing the HSSE program and supervision in the Project Company and Owner's team, fostering a culture of health, safety, security, and environment in alignment with Project Company and Stakeholder targets.
 



 Monitoring, coordinating, and reporting on multiple Contractors' activities at the site, challenging and negotiating with the EPC contractor when necessary to protect the Project Company's interests.
 



 Leading a highly skilled team and directing the Owner's Engineer to ensure seamless construction with highest levels of HSSE within the necessary quality, time and budget.
 



 Facilitating seamless communication and information exchanges among stakeholders, including project partners, local communities, and external parties.
   

  




**Requirements**

**Your Job Functions (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Oversee plant construction to ensure compliance with quality, schedule, and budget agreements.
* Manage HSSE implementation onsite and offsite, maintaining a strong HSSE culture.
* Coordinate activities of the Owner's Engineer, local contractors, local authorities and interface partners and Contractors.
* Monitor and enforce EPC Contractor's compliance with EPC Contract, Owner's requirements and International Standards
* Act as the primary link between the off\-taker, Owner's Engineer, EPC Contractor, third party, the Operator, \-\-etc to align battery limits and tie\-ins.
* Align technical and schedule interfaces between different contractors, ensuring contract conformity and project needs.
* Monitor Engineering \& Procurement, QA/QC and OE ensuring the EPC Contractor issuing the engineering packages and deliver procurement items ahead of construction needs.
* Organize and lead construction and progress management meetings with all stakeholders.
* Identify, assess, and escalate technical deviations, construction risks, and non\-conformities to the Project Company EMD, proposing effective mitigation and recovery measures.
* Manage contractual, commercial, and technical matters arising under the EPC Contract and WTA, in coordination with legal and commercial teams.
* Review, evaluate, and provide recommendations on change orders, variations, and claims submitted by contractors and service providers.
* Lead resolution meetings for technical and construction issues encountered on\-site and off\-site during execution.
* Lead QA/QC oversight and manage the SPV engineering teams including the Owner's Engineer  to witness, verify, and document key inspections and tests in accordance with the approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and project requirements.
* Lead risk assessment and risk identification workshops with the EPC Contractor and Owner's Engineer, ensuring all project risks are identified, formally recorded in the risk register periodically, and supported by clear mitigation and action plans.
* Interact with Sponsors, Lender's Engineer, Insurance Advisers, and O\&M teams.
* Issue progress reports and technical memoranda as required.
* Supervise milestone completion certificates, invoices, and mechanical completion certificates.
* Lead/participate as required in technical review committees as they may be defined during the construction period with sponsors.
* Facilitate the handover of the Project to the O\&M Team.
* Host visitors at the site and manage communications with stakeholders.



**Contractual/Commercial** 



* Timely reporting of contractual/commercial variances and proposing mitigation or alternative solutions.
* Assist in writing contractual letters to stakeholders.
* Identify and anticipate deliverables to relevant parties.
* Coordinate progress of commissioning and testing with Off\-taker and Dispatch Control Centre.
* Assist in claims management with Contractors and Service Providers.



**Qualifications \& Skill Sets** 



* University Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.
* Additional qualifications (project management/Construction Management) are preferred
* 15 \+years of project and site experience in large scale power projects, some in CCGT projects.
* Extensive knowledge of utilities and construction of Combined Cycle Power Plants.
* Experience in large infrastructure project execution.
* Experience with Turnkey EPC contractors. (with Chinese EPC contractor preferred)
* Strong technical knowledge and understanding of construction processes, contracts, and international standards.
* Contract/claim management and negotiation skills.
* Familiarity with BOO project structures, project finance documents, EPC contracts, PPAs.
* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently and lead teams.
* Strong ethical standards.

data.jd_text:
**Role:** 




 An Associate Director in Financial Crime Risk in Supervision is responsible for executing the Financial Crime Risk Team’s work plan. The Associate Director must ensure that a risk based, proportionate and efficient approach is maintained towards all the team’s supervisory activities.
 



  





 An Associate Director is expected to oversee assigned regulatory projects related to financial crime risk and relevant business model within the team, across the Supervision Department and the DFSA, as well as supporting on related policy work.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 The Associate Director is expected to devote the majority of his/her time towards managerial and operational level tasks, as well as support policy development. The Associate Director will assist the Director and contribute to the work of the team with the following key responsibilities:
 



  






 Technical Guidance
 



* Act as a technical expert in respective risk area and provide internal trainings as needed.
* Provide guidance to the team in all aspects of financial crime risk for regulated entities in order to ensure delivery of effective and efficient risk\-based supervision.
* Support DFSA Divisions by providing guidance in all aspects of financial crime risk in line with the DFSA’s objectives.
* Monitor developments in relevant international and regional regulatory standards and in the financial services industry and provide inputs and updates.



  






 Strategy Formulation, Implementation, Planning and Projects
 




  




* Contribute to DFSA\-wide and Supervision Division\-wide strategic direction, business planning and policy formation. Ensure effective cascading of approved strategy, business plans and policies into the day\-to\-day management of the team.
* Participate in the development and implementation of supervision strategy for the team, consistent with the DFSA\-wide goals and objectives.
* Ensure DFSA\-wide projects as captured in the Business Plan relevant to the AD are completed effectively, on\-time and within budget.
* Be expected to devote a considerable level of time toward managerial, policy, outreach and other assigned projects.



  






 People Management
 



* Manage and support the effective achievement of the objectives of respective areas of focus through setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, provision of formal and informal feedback and appraisal in order to maximize subordinate and the overall performance.
* Ensure the key performance indicators, performance reviews, leave approvals and timesheets are completed in an accurate and timely manner for self and team members.
* Support the professional development programs of the DFSA through program development, delivery and participation. Support and contribute to the DFSA graduates training program.
* When requested, effectively lead the team in the absence of the Director.



  





**Educational Background** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management or Economics. A post graduate degree in similar fields would be considered as an advantage.
* Evidence of continuing professional education relevant to target position.
* Professional qualifications in finance, risk management, quantitative analysis, etc. such as ACAMS, CFA, FRM, PRM, etc. would be considered as a plus.



  





**Professional Experience** 



* 10\+ years of regulatory, compliance or risk management experience required in a broadly equivalent financial services regulator and/or a regulated entity, with a minimum of 2 years in managerial/ supervisory roles in one or more of these functions being desirable. Managerial roles might include project leadership / management roles or equivalent with a demonstrated ability to mentor and motivate staff.
* Experience in dealing with financial services regulators, standard setters and members of Board of Directors and senior executives.
* Preferably experience in the development and implementation of regulatory standards and policy analysis.
* Experience of country self\-assessments against the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) 40 recommendations; national risk assessments pursuant to FATF Recommendation 1; and involvement with a FATF country mutual evaluation would be considered an advantage.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 



* Strong and up to date knowledge and technical expertise in dealing with financial services regulations and relevant international standard setters.
* Robust understanding of the responsibilities/role of the regulator and of what it means to be a risk\-based regulator.
* An in\-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and its unique characteristics with proven technical knowledge and understanding of the key risks in the sector.
* Deep understanding of current and emerging risk management trends/issues.
* Appreciation of the unique features of the regulatory regime in the DIFC and understanding of the nature of the financial service activities offered by Authorised Firms operating in the DIFC.
* Strategic vision, strong analytical thinking and creativity; capacity to clearly articulate options and trade\-offs and ability to apply judgment.
* Influential skills and ability to lead meetings and deliver difficult messages, when necessary.
* Excellent people leadership, planning, organisation and time management skills embodied in a professional, diplomatic and ethical attitude.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to address senior executives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including ability to engage effectively and confidently with international counterparts.
* Capacity to deliver high quality work to demanding timescales.
* Be able to work flexibility, autonomously, and co\-operatively in a collaborative team environment.

data.jd_text:
**The School**
 Deira International School (DIS) is an Outstanding BSO\- and KHDA\-rated, award\-winning school located on a beautiful campus in Festival City, Dubai. In 2023, DIS was awarded the Education Excellence Award for ‘School Team of the Year’ and is also a Platinum Award holder for ‘Best Place to Work’, reflecting our strong commitment to staff wellbeing and a thriving school community.
   

  

**Education**
 With students aged 3–18, DIS is a not\-for\-profit school and part of the Al\-Futtaim Education Foundation. Founded in 2005, the school is renowned for providing an outstanding, inclusive, and holistic education. Our most recent inspection highlighted the following strengths:
   

  

* Staff are overwhelmingly proud of the school and believe it is well led, safe, and inclusive
* The quality of teaching, learning, and assessment across the school is outstanding
* Teachers have high expectations and consistently challenge pupils to do their best
* Staff feel respected, valued, and treated fairly
* The curriculum is precisely planned, well sequenced, and builds effectively on prior learning
* There is a strong focus on academic progress and achievement


 DIS is home to a diverse student body representing over 90 nationalities, which is fundamental to the school’s community ethos. Our exceptional facilities support a holistic approach to education, with rich opportunities across sport, performing arts, technology, leadership, creativity, and academic enrichment.
   

  

 Although non\-selective at admission, our students achieve exceptional examination results, comparable to top UK schools, and progress to leading universities worldwide. Digital literacy is embedded across the curriculum as we prepare students for the demands of a rapidly changing world.
   

  

 In the Early Years, our personalised, play\-based continuous provision ensures students are rigorously assessed against the EYFS framework, developing strong foundations for future learning. In Primary, pupils benefit from a broad and enriching curriculum, including a range of non\-core subjects. In Secondary, students complete IGCSEs in Year 11 before progressing to the IB Diploma Programme (IBDP) or IB Career\-related Programme (IBCP) in Years 12 and 13\. DIS is governed by the Al\-Futtaim Education Foundation (AFEF), a not\-for\-profit initiative of the Al\-Futtaim family, supporting the vision of the Government of Dubai and KHDA to deliver future\-ready education while maximising positive social impact.
   

  

**The Role: Head of Performing Arts**
 We are seeking an exceptional and inspirational leader to join Deira International School as Head of Performing Arts. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a successful department encompassing Drama and Music within one of Dubai’s leading international schools.
   

  

 Performing Arts is a vibrant and highly valued part of school life at DIS. Both Drama and Music enjoy strong uptake at IGCSE and IB Diploma level, alongside extensive participation in co\-curricular activities, performances, ensembles, productions, and competitions. Students regularly engage in regional and international events through organisations such as COBIS and BSME.
   

  

 The department plays a central role in the wider life of the school, leading productions, concerts, recitals, showcases, assemblies, and celebration events throughout the year. Previous productions have included Oliver! and High School Musical. The successful candidate will continue to develop an ambitious and inclusive Performing Arts programme that inspires creativity and excellence.
   

  

 The department benefits from excellent facilities, including a dedicated drama studio, specialist music spaces, rehearsal rooms, and a multipurpose hall with full stage and performance equipment.
   

  

 As Head of Performing Arts, the successful candidate will lead curriculum development, teaching and learning, enrichment, and departmental improvement across Drama and Music. They will be a visible and enthusiastic leader who inspires students and staff while promoting collaboration, innovation, and high expectations.
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will Demonstrate**
* A clear vision for excellence in Performing Arts education
* The ability to inspire, motivate, and develop others
* Excellent organisational and communication skills
* A commitment to collaboration and positive relationships
* High expectations of student achievement and participation
* A passion for enrichment and the wider life of the school
* Confidence leading productions, performances, and events


**The Successful Applicant Will Be Required To Have**
* Experience teaching GCSE Drama, with A Level and/or IB experience desirable
* Leadership experience within Performing Arts
* A B.Ed. or degree in a related subject, plus PGCE/PGDE or equivalent
* A proven track record of outstanding teaching and learning
* Experience leading or supporting productions and enrichment programmes
* A belief in the potential of every student to achieve highly
* The ability to contribute fully to the wider life of the school and inspire participation across Performing Arts

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview/Purpose**
 The Lead – Business Operations, Global Oncology will play a critical role in driving launch excellence and early access strategies across small to mid\-sized markets where Glenmark Oncology does not have dedicated in\-country oncology leadership.
   

  

 This role will act as a strategic and operational partner to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology, ensuring organizational readiness, optimal resource allocation, and execution of commercial infrastructure (including CRM and analytics). The incumbent will also serve as support to the Global Head in governance, decision\-making, and cross\-functional alignment.
   

  

**Overall Job Responsibilities**
* Launch Excellence \& Early Access Strategy
* Lead the development and execution of launch strategies for oncology assets in small\-to\-mid\-sized markets.
* Design scalable, repeatable “go\-to\-market” models tailored for distributor\-led or hybrid markets.
* Drive early access strategies including:
* Named Patient Programs (NPPs)
* Compassionate use programs
* Managed access agreements
* Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Supply teams to ensure timely market entry.
* Develop launch readiness frameworks, KPIs, and tracking mechanisms.
* Market Development (Non\-Core / White Space Markets)
* Identify, prioritize, and assess new market opportunities where Glenmark lacks oncology presence.
* Build market entry playbooks (partner vs. direct vs. hybrid models).
* Support distributor selection, onboarding, and performance management.
* Ensure alignment of local execution with global brand strategy.
* Commercial Operations \& Infrastructure
* Lead implementation and optimization of CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce Health Cloud).
* Establish standardized commercial processes, reporting dashboards, and performance tracking.
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making through analytics and insights generation.
* Oversee commercial excellence initiatives including:
* Sales force effectiveness (where applicable)
* Omnichannel engagement frameworks
* Digital enablement tools
* Organizational Readiness \& Capability Building
* Partner with the Head of Global Commercial Oncology to ensure readiness for upcoming launches.
* Define target operating models for new markets.
* Support hiring strategy, role design, and capability frameworks (especially for distributor markets).
* Develop training frameworks and onboarding programs for new teams/partners.

* Lead commercial budgeting and resource allocation across emerging markets.
* Optimize deployment of financial and human resources based on market potential and strategic priority.
* Track ROI on launch investments and commercial initiatives.
* Support long\-range planning (LRP) and annual operating plans (AOP).
* Strategic Planning \& Governance
* Act as a strategic advisor and deputy to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology.
* Support development of global oncology commercial strategy.
* Lead cross\-functional governance forums and business reviews.
* Drive alignment across global, regional, and local stakeholders.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Serve as a central coordination point across: Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance
* Ensure integrated execution of launch and commercialization plans.
* Competitive Intelligence \& Market Insights
* Monitor competitive landscape across oncology markets.
* Benchmark best practices from leading oncology players (MNCs).
* Translate insights into actionable strategies for Glenmark.
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* Ensure all commercial activities adhere to global compliance standards and local regulations.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to distributor\-led markets and early access programs.

* Successful launch of oncology assets in priority emerging markets.
* Time\-to\-market reduction in non\-core geographies.
* CRM implementation effectiveness and adoption rates.
* Achievement of early access program targets.
* Budget adherence and ROI optimization.
* Distributor performance and market expansion outcomes.


**Key Relationships/Stakeholders**
**External**
* Oncology KOLs and treatment centers
* Oncology societies and networks
* Strategic partners and service providers


**Internal (other Than Direct Reports)**
* Regional/Country Commercial Leadership Teams
* Global Oncology Franchise \& Brand Teams
* Country Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Finance, and Supply Chain


**Desired Experience And Knowledge**
**Educational**
* MBA or master’s degree in business, Life Sciences, or related field preferred


**Experience**
* 12–15\+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech experience, with a strong focus on innovative oncology.
* Proven track record in global or regional commercial roles
* Experience in launch excellence, emerging markets, or distributor\-led markets.
* Experience operating in complex, fast\-evolving oncology markets.
* Prior country\-level or franchise leadership experience is strongly preferred.


**Knowledge And Skills (Functional And Technical)**
* Strong understanding of oncology market access and early access pathways.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce).
* Ability to work in cross functional groups and teams with a complex matrix organization.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and build new market structures
* Exceptional stakeholder management, influence, and communication skills.
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership
* High ethical standards with uncompromising compliance orientation.

**Head of Department \| Psychology**
**American University of Sharjah**
 The Department of Psychology in the College of Arts and Sciences at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applications for the position of Head of Department. The department seeks a collaborative and visionary leader with a record of excellence in teaching, research and service, and a strong commitment to student success and faculty development.
   

  

**About The Department**
 The department offers a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology and contributes significantly to the university’s general education curriculum. Faculty members are engaged in diverse areas of research, including mental health and well\-being; cognitive psychology and psycholinguistics; organizational psychology; and social, cultural and personality psychology. The department values multidisciplinary collaboration and emphasizes both scientific rigor and applied engagement with the community.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Applicants must meet the following minimum qualifications:
   

  

* PhD in Psychology or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum rank of Associate Professor (Professor preferred).
* A record of effective and inclusive academic leadership, including experience in personnel management and decision\-making.
* Evidence of excellence in teaching, research and service.
* Experience with program accreditation, curriculum development and faculty evaluation.
* Familiarity with North American models of higher education.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 In addition to the above, the college will give preference to candidates who demonstrate:
   

  

* Experience as a department chair, program director or equivalent academic leadership role.
* Success in developing and supporting undergraduate and/or graduate programs.
* Commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration within the college and across the university.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor faculty, support student engagement and foster research productivity.
* A clear vision for the future development of the department, consistent with the strategic goals of the college and university.


**Responsibilities**
 The Head of Department will:
   

  

* Provide strategic leadership and foster a collegial and inclusive departmental culture.
* Foster and promote the professional growth of faculty in teaching and research.
* Oversee curriculum planning, program assessment and accreditation.
* Represent and advocate for the department within the college and university.
* Recruit and retain high\-quality faculty and students.
* Engage in teaching and scholarship at the undergraduate and/or graduate level.
* Participate in university service and governance.


**Date of Commencement**
 The position begins mid\-August 2026\.
   

  

**Application Procedure**
 Applicants should apply online at \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01");" rel\="nofollow"\>https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01\.
   

  

**Applicants Should Submit**
* A cover letter describing their research, teaching and administrative experience, and articulating their vision for how they can contribute to the department’s development and success.
* A current curriculum vitae.
* Names and contact information for three referees (references will be contacted only for shortlisted candidates).


*Additional materials may be requested from candidates advancing to later stages of the search.*
 Applications received by December 15, 2025, will receive full consideration; review will continue until the position is filled.
   

  

**About American University Of Sharjah**
 American University of Sharjah (AUS) is a comprehensive, independent, non\-profit, coeducational institution of higher education that promotes excellence in teaching, learning, research and creative work. AUS fosters a community that celebrates diversity and whose members are committed to the ideals of open intellectual inquiry, ethical behavior and civic responsibility.
   

  

 AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to approximately 6,000 students from over 100 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. Among the top 18 percent of ranked universities in the world (QS World University Rankings, 2026\), AUS is consistently among the top ten universities in the Arab region (QS Arab Region University Rankings, 2026\).
   

  

 AUS is located in the heart of Sharjah’s University City, adjacent to the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park and just minutes from Sharjah International Airport and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The campus is situated in a vibrant and cosmopolitan area offering abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.aus.edu.

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 




  





 talabat is the leading on\-demand food and non\-food delivery platform in MENA, operating across 8 countries and processing hundreds of millions of orders annually.
 



 We're part of Delivery Hero, the global leader in online food delivery and q\-commerce, and we're engineering\-first. Our teams operate under
 **eXtreme Programming (XP) principles** 
 — TDD, pair programming, continuous refactoring, and trunk\-based development. We believe
 **quality enables speed** 
 , and our hiring reflects that. Our engineering culture is a key competitive advantage, and we're looking for leaders who embody it.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





**What you'll own** 




  





 As
 **Senior Engineering Manager** 
 , you'll lead multiple engineering teams (typically 4 squads, \~20 engineers) across a single technical domain. You're accountable for:
 


* **Domain\-level technical strategy** 
 — Work with product leadership and your teams to define a 12–18 month technical vision for your domain
* **Team health and growth** 
 — Build an environment where engineers thrive: hiring, developing ICs, mentoring junior managers, and creating psychological safety
* **Delivery excellence** 
 — Guide your teams through discovery, planning, and execution using small\-batch delivery and continuous feedback loops
* **Business impact** 
 — Translate product objectives into technical solutions; quantify and communicate the impact of your domain's work
* **Cross\-functional leadership** 
 — Work closely with product, design, and business partners to resolve ambiguity and drive alignment
* **Technical decision\-making** 
 — Guide your teams on system design, architecture, and engineering practices while maintaining talabat's standards for scalability, security, and performance



  





**90\-day, 6\-month, and 12\-month outcomes** 




  





**90 days:** 
 You've onboarded your teams, understood their technical roadmap and pain points, and delivered your first feedback to your manager on domain health and near\-term priorities.
 



**6 months:** 
 Your teams are shipping value consistently; you've identified one emerging technical leader and started mentoring them; you've coached your teams through at least one cross\-domain initiative; code quality and shipping velocity are on track or improving.
 



**12 months:** 
 Your domain has a clear technical vision communicated across the org; you've grown at least one engineer significantly (either toward IC4/Staff or toward management); your teams ship with confidence; you're contributing to 1–2 strategic initiatives beyond your domain; you're mentoring or developing a potential future manager.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**What you'll bring** 




  





**Leadership \& people management** 



* 4\+ years of hands\-on technical leadership experience managing engineering teams
* Demonstrated ability to hire, mentor, and grow engineers — we care about your track record of developing people, not just technical skills
* Comfort with cross\-functional leadership: working with product, design, business partners, and other engineering teams
* Emotional intelligence: you navigate ambiguity, handle conflict constructively, and create psychological safety for your teams



  





**Technical depth** 



* 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience in production systems
* Deep understanding of
 **at least one** 
 of: distributed systems, backend systems, data platforms, mobile platforms, or web\-scale infrastructure
* Proven ability to work
 **across diverse technology stacks** 
 — we care that you've made architecture decisions that matter, not that you've used every specific tool
* Hands\-on understanding of XP practices: TDD, pair programming, continuous refactoring, and trunk\-based development (or strong willingness to learn and lead talabat's approach)



  





**Engineering sense** 



* You think about non\-functional requirements: scalability, reliability, latency, cost efficiency, and security — not just feature delivery
* You've navigated the tradeoffs between speed and technical debt; you know when to optimize and when to simplify
* You've led or been part of domain\-level decisions (tech stack migrations, architectural changes, platform initiatives)



  





**Nice\-to\-haves** 



* Experience leading multiple teams or a domain in a high\-growth environment
* Exposure to eXtreme Programming practices (XP culture is learnable but experience is valuable)
* Background in marketplace, delivery, or logistics optimization
* Experience mentoring or developing other engineering managers
* Familiarity with modern cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)



  





**Additional information** 




  





**Why this role, why talabat** 




  




* **Scale with purpose:** 
 You'll impact millions of daily orders across MENA while building a technical foundation that's proven to scale
* **Engineering culture that works:** 
 We practice XP genuinely — TDD, pair programming, continuous delivery — not as Agile theater. Our engineers ship faster
 *because* 
 we focus on quality
* **Autonomous teams:** 
 Your teams own their roadmap and their quality. You're not a bottleneck; you're an enabler
* **Mentoring and growth:** 
 If you want to grow into a Director role, we have a clear path: multi\-domain scope → tribe leadership → org strategy
* **Real problems:** 
 Food delivery in MENA is complex. You'll solve problems that matter: serving millions, operating across 8 countries, balancing fast delivery with sustainability

 A day in the life
   

  

 The role is field based and requires a significant level of travel as well as requiring flexibility to work a variety of hours as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays.

**Portfolio \& Program Delivery Management**
* Govern and oversee, ensuring delivery commitments across multiple streams are met within approved scope, cost, timeline, and quality parameters.
* Review, challenge, and approve delivery plans prepared by Technology Delivery Managers reporting into the role.
* Proactively manage cross domain dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and resource constraints across GTB platforms and core banking integration tracks.

data.jd_text:
Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting\-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.
   

  





 With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Egis is building its data centre capability across the UAE and wider MESA region. We are seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of that emerging practice \- setting standards, leading major bids, and acting as our senior technical authority on mission\-critical work. Reporting to the Regional Director \- MEP, this is a leadership role with real scope to shape a practice from the ground up, backed by the reach and resources of a global consultancy.
   

  





**What You'll Do**



* Provide technical leadership and sign\-off authority across all data centre projects in the region
* Define and maintain MEP/ELV design standards and delivery frameworks for mission\-critical work
* Lead technical input on major bids and proposals across the MESA region
* Build and mentor a specialist data centre team within a 400\+ strong MEP/ELV practice
* Engage with clients, hyperscalers, EPCs, and authorities at Director level
* Drive innovation across BIM, parametric design, and AI\-assisted workflows
* Represent Egis externally as the data centre practice establishes its market presence


**Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of MEP engineering experience with a significant portion in data centre or mission\-critical environments
* Demonstrable experience at Technical Director, Associate Director, or equivalent level
* Deep expertise across data centre MEP/ELV systems: HV/LV, generators, UPS, precision cooling, EPMS, DCIM, and ICT infrastructure
* Familiarity with Uptime Institute, TIA\-942, and EN 50600 requirements
* Strong commercial awareness across fee negotiation, scope definition, and risk management
* Degree\-qualified with Chartered Engineer status (CEng or regional equivalent) required
* GCC experience preferred; UAE track record a strong advantage


**Additional Information**
* 400\+ strong, award\-winning MEP/ELV team across UAE, KSA, India, Jordan, and Egypt
* Live and growing pipeline of hyperscale and mission\-critical opportunities across the region
* Platform to build a specialist data centre practice from the ground up
* Backed by the depth and reach of a global consultancy
* Competitive Director\-level package and UAE benefits

data.raw_snippet:

**Key Accountabilities**
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose Summary**
 Provides an efficient, accurate and timely Contracts and Purchasing Service for internal clients according to University policies and procedures. Focuses on vendor management. Ensures that each purchase is value for money and cost effective.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 GENERAL PURCHASING
   

  

* Purchases a variety of goods and services for both Campuses from local and international sources in line with the University By\-Laws.
* Materials procured range from: computers (hardware, software, consumables, accessories), audio video equipment, office equipment, office and classroom furniture, lab equipment, printing materials, stationery, text books, periodicals, vehicles, building materials and renovation services, rental of equipment/vehicles and maintaining the University Insurance Policies (Public Liability, Fire, Burglary and Vehicular), for both campuses.
* Interprets purchase requests, investigates supply sources and negotiates best terms and conditions in line with user specifications.
* Scrutinizes specifications carefully to ensure that they are generic in nature during enquiry preparation stage, and to advise or obtain clarification from end user when such anomalies appear.
* Solicits quotations in line with the purchasing method approved by the Director/line manager. Scrutinizes vendor quotations and prepares bid summaries as required. Makes recommendations where possible.
* Vets and benchmarks prices obtained through referring to historical data, web published prices, and/or checking with end users to compare budgeted and estimated costs with actual prices.
* Expedites orders to ensure that goods and services are delivered within contractual deadlines and ensures that end users are kept advised of delivery situation at all times.
* Liaises with vendors regarding discrepancies and damage reports to ensure correct replacement of materials in accordance with order specifications.
* Issues amendments in case of increase/decrease of quantities and cancellation of orders and ensures accuracy of data at all times.
* Ensures through liaison with end users that vendor invoices routed for payment approval, are not held up without reason.
* When requested by line manager, must be able to produce and place on record the complete history of a specific purchase, for presentation or audit purposes.
* Answers vendor and client queries as required.


 TENDERS
   

  

* Prepares vendor tender documents complete with technical specifications, conditions, bill of quantities, date for opening envelopes, tender validity, terms of payment and guarantee, in line with the Director’s/line manager’s instructions.
* Monitors closing dates for tenders and ensures that tender opening sessions are held on the day of closing.
* Receives tender documents and prepares appropriate record in preparation of the tender opening session.
* Passes on all tenders with appropriate record to the tender opening committee.
* Forwards technical documents/catalogues to appointed Technical Committee for technical evaluation. Addresses clarifications arising from technical queries by evaluation teams.
* On receipt of technical evaluation from end user, opens Commercial envelopes and prepares the Bid Summary.
* On the advice of the Director/ line manager, prepares orders/fax of intent.
* Prepares blanket orders according to standards, procedures and University By\-Laws.
* Collects Performance Bonds and Bank Guarantees and maintains their security through the Finance Department. Returns bonds to unsuccessful vendors as required.
* Monitors contractual delivery and completion deadlines and liaises with Contracts Specialist for any delays in contract delivery.


**Other**
* Must be fully conversant with, and able to prepare and issue requests for quotations on the Tejari.com business to business exchange.
* Must be fully conversant with the Purchasing module of the Banner System and be able to process Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders in line with adopted procedures.
* Maintains confidentiality of purchasing information and does not disseminate information to any Party, unless authorized by the Director/line manager.
* Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of all procedures in the By\-Laws and the University’s purchasing terms and conditions.
* Must be conversant with the Storekeeper’s functions to fill in duties when required to do so.
* Identify, mitigate and escalate procurement risks to enable the organization to meet its obligations and maximize business opportunities
* Maintain and update procurement records and generate reports on procurement and contract activity to meet organizational compliance requirements and provide access to procurement information
* Performs other related duties as assigned and needed.


 DEGREE OF INDEPENDENCE/COMPLEXITY OF ENVIRONMENT
   

  

* Works independently to deal with different clients while maintaining confidentiality and a professional manner. Coordinates and directs a variety of purchasing requests, tenders, queries and correspondence. Mainly works to meet deadlines and must be able to function under time constraints.


 WORKING RELATIONSHIPS/IMPACT OF INTERACTIONS
   

  

* Works closely with the Director/line manager, C\&P, members in the Department and other departments, particularly Finance to ensure that the complete procurement cycle is completed effectively, through payment of invoices to vendors.
* Must communicate effectively and professionally with internal and external clients.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
 Must possess a Minimum of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution and 2 years relevant professional experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
   

  

 Experience working in a similar role in a government or higher education institution will be highly preferred.
   

  

**Other Requirements**
* Excellent computer skills required.
* Knowledge of purchasing procedures is preferred.
* Arabic/ English bilingual an asset.


 COMPETENCIES
   

  

* Communication \-Able to share information in an effective \& collaborative manner, both verbally and in writing.
* Customer \& Service Focused \- Demonstrates a spirit of service excellence
* Results \& Action Orientation \- Demonstrates initiative to generate improvements and foster positive outcomes.
* Builds Effective Interpersonal Relationships \- Demonstrates interpersonal effectiveness in the workplace.
* Knowledge \& Technical Competency \- Demonstrates proficiency in technical and job knowledge aspects of the position to achieve high level of performance. Able and willing to learn.

**The Team**

**How You Will Contribute**

**Job Description**
**Finance Manager – Project Accounting (Real Estate Development)**
**Location:** 
 UAE
   

  

**Department:** 
 Finance \& Accounts
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Chief Financial Officer (CFO) / Finance Director
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Finance Manager – Project Accounting will be responsible for overseeing the financial management of real estate development projects from feasibility assessment through project completion. The role requires strong expertise in project accounting, financial modeling, project finance, escrow management, budgeting, cost control, and stakeholder management with banks, investors, consultants, contractors, and regulatory authorities. The incumbent will play a key role in ensuring financial viability, funding availability, compliance with UAE real estate regulations, and accurate financial reporting of development projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Project Feasibility \& Financial Analysis


 Prepare and review project feasibility studies for new real estate developments. Develop detailed financial models incorporating sales projections, construction costs, financing costs, cash flow forecasts, and profitability analysis. Conduct sensitivity analysis and scenario planning for project viability assessment. Evaluate investment returns including IRR, NPV, ROI, and project margins. Support management in investment decision\-making and project acquisitions.
   

  

* Fund Raising \& Project Financing


 Lead debt and equity fund\-raising initiatives for development projects. Prepare financial information packages, presentations, and lender information memorandums. Liaise with banks, financial institutions, investors, and advisors for project financing requirements. Coordinate due diligence processes with lenders and investors. Negotiate financing terms, covenant requirements, and facility documentation in coordination with management and legal teams. Monitor compliance with financing agreements and reporting obligations.
   

  

* Banking \& Financial Institution Management


**Requirements**
 Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions. Coordinate project finance drawdowns and utilization of facilities. Monitor loan covenants and reporting requirements. Facilitate issuance, renewals, amendments, and cancellations of:
   

  

* Performance Guarantees Advance Payment Guarantees Retention Guarantees Corporate Guarantees Other banking instruments
* Escrow Account Management


 Ensure compliance with UAE Real Estate Regulatory Authority (RERA) and escrow regulations. Coordinate with project auditors, consultants, and escrow banks for fund release approvals. Review and submit payment release applications from escrow accounts. Monitor escrow collections and utilization against approved project budgets. Maintain accurate records and reconciliations of escrow transactions. Liaise with regulatory authorities and escrow agents on project\-related matters.
   

  

* Project Budgeting \& Cost Control


 Develop project budgets and cash flow forecasts. Monitor actual expenditures against approved budgets. Analyze cost variances and recommend corrective actions. Review commitments, contracts, and purchase orders to ensure budget compliance. Support value engineering initiatives to optimize project profitability. Prepare monthly project cost reports and management dashboards.
   

  

* Payment Certification \& Contractor Management


 Review interim payment applications submitted by contractors and consultants. Verify payment certifications against approved contracts and project progress reports. Coordinate with project management and consultants to validate work completion. Ensure timely processing and release of payments in accordance with contractual terms. Monitor retention, advance recoveries, and variation orders.
   

  

* Project Accounting \& Financial Reporting


 Maintain complete accounting records for development projects. Ensure proper allocation and capitalization of project costs. Manage project\-wise revenue recognition and cost accounting. Prepare monthly project profit and loss statements. Monitor project cash flows and funding requirements. Ensure compliance with IFRS and company accounting policies. Support annual audits and statutory reporting requirements.
   

  

* Financial Planning \& Cash Flow Management


 Prepare short\-term and long\-term project cash flow forecasts. Monitor funding requirements throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure adequate liquidity for project execution. Optimize utilization of debt and equity financing.
   

  

* Stakeholder Coordination


**Liaise With**
* Banks and Financial Institutions Investors and Shareholders Project Auditors Escrow Banks Consultants and Contractors Legal Advisors Regulatory Authorities Internal Project and Sales Teams


 Provide financial insights and reports to senior management.
   

  

* Governance, Compliance \& Risk Management


 Ensure compliance with UAE regulations, escrow requirements, financing agreements, and company policies. Monitor project financial risks and recommend mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal controls over project expenditures and funding utilization. Support implementation of ERP and project accounting systems.
   

  

* Taxation \& Statutory Compliance


 Ensure timely VAT compliance on project transactions, including output VAT on sales and recovery of input VAT on construction costs. Ensure compliance with UAE Corporate Tax requirements, including registration, computation, and filing for project entities. Coordinate with tax consultants and auditors on tax planning, assessments, and clarifications. Maintain proper tax records, documentation, and reconciliations for development projects.
   

  

* Team Leadership \& Development


 Lead, mentor, and develop the project finance and accounting team. Allocate responsibilities and review the work of project accountants and finance staff. Set performance objectives and support training and capability building within the team.
   

  

* Insurance Management


 Coordinate project and construction insurance cover (e.g., Contractor All\-Risk, third\-party liability) with brokers and insurers. Ensure adequate insurance is maintained throughout the project lifecycle and renewed on time. Manage insurance claims and recoveries in coordination with project and legal teams. Verify that insurance requirements under financing agreements and contracts are met.
   

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
 Accuracy of project feasibility and financial models. Timely closure of debt and equity funding requirements. Compliance with financing covenants and escrow regulations. Budget variance management. Project cash flow accuracy. Timely release of escrow funds. Project profitability achievement. Accuracy and timeliness of project financial reporting. Effective management of bank guarantees and financing facilities.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
 Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or related field. Professional qualification preferred:
   

  

* CA ACCA CPA CMA


**Experience**
 8–12 years of finance experience, with at least 5 years in UAE real estate development. Strong experience in:
   

  

* Project Finance Real Estate Development Accounting Financial Modeling Feasibility Studies Escrow Management Debt and Equity Fund Raising Project Budgeting and Cost Control Bank Guarantee Management RERA and Escrow Compliance


 Experience dealing with UAE banks for project financing is essential.
   

  

**Technical Skills**
 Advanced Financial Modeling (Excel) Project Feasibility Analysis Project Accounting IFRS Knowledge Cash Flow Forecasting ERP Systems (Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Yardi, Property Developer ERP, etc.) Power BI and Financial Reporting Tools Banking and Treasury Management Commercial Awareness Analytical and Problem\-Solving Ability Stakeholder Management Leadership and Team Management Strong Communication and Presentation Skills

data.jd_text:
**About Arada**
 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the independent Cost Control Audit \& Governance function across pre\- and post\-contract stages for Arada’s portfolio. Operating as a mandatory control point, this role ensures absolute baseline integrity, strictly audits commercial recommendations prior to package awards, and enforces rigorous governance over the Forecast Final Cost (FFC) versus project budget, disciplined cost governance, and financial visibility for all projects. The role drives cost strategy, reporting integrity, and team capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Pre\-Award Independent Audit \& Gateway Control
* Mandatory Tender Sign\-Off: Review, audit, and provide formal feedback on all Pre\-Tender Estimates (PTE) and Tender Recommendation Reports before any package finalization.
* Independent Budget Verification: Act as an independent control point to cross\-verify procurement and commercial tender returns against the approved business case.
* Executive Gateway Reporting: Prepare and present concise "Gate Review" commercial analysis briefs to the Project Controls Director, CDO, and CEO, explicitly highlighting budget variances and risks prior to contract award.
* Design\-Stage Cost Checks: Monitor schematic and detailed design progressions to flag budget deviations early, forcing mandatory Value Engineering (VE) triggers if baselines are breached.
* Post\-Award Budget Governance \& FFC Control
* Budget vs. FFC Reconciliation: Own the monthly audit of Budget versus Forecast Final Cost (FFC) across all active assets. Identify and challenge hidden cost overruns or optimistic forecasting by project site teams.
* Contingency Drawdown Audit: Establish and enforce strict governance over project risks and contingencies. Validate that any drawdown request is backed by robust data and contractually justified.
* Trend Log \& Early Warning Governance: Implement and oversee an active Trend Log system to capture potential variations, design changes, and claims weeks before they manifest as formal commercial risks.
* Cost Monitoring, Reporting \& BI Automation
* Data Integrity Auditing: Validate and sign off on all monthly cost reports, cash flow projections, and cost\-to\-complete metrics, ensuring they represent a single source of truth.
* Executive Dashboards: Drive the development of automated, live Power BI dashboards for the C\-suite, focusing strictly on Management by Exception by flagging projects tracking outside a 5% variance threshold.
* Proprietary Benchmarking: Oversee the construction and maintenance of a live internal cost\-per\-square\-foot benchmarking database using historical data from completed Arada phases.
* Team Leadership \& Interface
* Internal Audit Team Management: Manage and mentor Senior Cost Controllers and Analysts, instilling a culture of objective, data\-driven financial auditing.
* Cross\-Departmental Interface: Partner effectively with the established Pre\- and Post\-Contract Commercial, Procurement, and Project Management teams while maintaining strict departmental independence.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* MRICS certification is highly preferred.


**Experience**
* 12–15 years of experience in cost control, commercial management, or quantity surveying within top\-tier developers or international consultancies in the UAE.


**Technical Skills**
* Deep proficiency in enterprise cost management systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and reporting capabilities.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional analytical authority with the confidence and credibility to challenge commercial submissions and present objective risk data directly to executive leadership.

**About The Role**
 The Design Manager is a central operational and creative role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for ensuring the studio runs efficiently, design output meets the agency's quality standards, and every project is delivered on time and to brief.
data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The Design Manager is a central operational and creative role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for ensuring the studio runs efficiently, design output meets the agency's quality standards, and every project is delivered on time and to brief.
   

  

 Reporting to the Art Director and Senior Client Director, the Design Manager sits at the intersection of creative production and project management. You will own the day\-to\-day traffic of creative requests and deliverables \- coordinating briefs, managing workloads, and ensuring the right resource is on the right job at the right time.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that requires both design capability and operational discipline. You will produce and oversee creative work across the agency's client portfolio while maintaining the systems and processes that keep the studio performing at pace.
   

  

 The Design Manager will be a key figure in the day\-to\-day life of the creative team \- supporting the Art Director, working closely with account and marketing teams, and ensuring that creative delivery across all clients is consistent, organised, and to the standard the agency demands.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Traffic \& Workflow Management**
* Own the studio traffic system \- managing the intake, prioritisation, and scheduling of all creative briefs across the agency.
* Maintain a clear and up\-to\-date overview of all active projects, deadlines, and resource allocation at all times.
* Work with the account and marketing teams to brief in work accurately, ensuring all jobs are scoped correctly before entering the studio.
* Anticipate capacity pressures and flag resource conflicts early, escalating to the Art Director and Senior Client Director when required.
* Manage freelance and supplier relationships to flex studio capacity during peak periods, ensuring quality and consistency are maintained.


**Design Output \& Quality Control**
* Produce design work across a range of formats \- social content, campaign assets, event branding, presentation design, OOH, print and digital, to a high and consistent standard.
* Review and quality\-check all creative output before it leaves the studio, ensuring work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and production\-ready.
* Maintain brand consistency across all client accounts, upholding the visual standards set by the Art Director.
* Manage the preparation and trafficking of final artwork files for print, digital, and environmental use, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification.
* Oversee version control and file management across the studio, keeping asset libraries organised and accessible.


**Project \& Delivery Management**
* Track all jobs from brief through to final delivery, proactively managing timelines and communicating progress to relevant stakeholders.
* Identify and resolve production issues before they impact delivery, problem\-solving under pressure without compromising quality.
* Manage the review and approval process for creative work, coordinating feedback rounds efficiently and keeping projects moving.
* Produce clear status reports and delivery schedules as required by the account and client teams.
* Ensure all project documentation \- briefs, schedules, sign\-off records — is accurate, complete, and properly filed.


**Client \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with the wider team and departments to manage workload, set realistic timelines, and ensure creative capacity is allocated effectively.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with internal teams on project status, flagging risks and changes as they arise.
* Support the Art Director and Senior Client Director in preparing and presenting work where required.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with external suppliers \- print partners, production studios, photographers, and video producers and build a strong database of contacts, suppliers and agency friends we can tap into.


**Creative Team Support**
* Support and coordinate junior members of the creative team, helping to manage their workload and develop their understanding of agency processes.
* Contribute actively to the studio's creative culture \- bringing energy, rigour, and a commitment to standards to everything you do.
* Stay current with design trends, production techniques, and tools relevant to sport, events, and brand marketing.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and play an active role in maintaining the quality of the agency's output across all accounts.


**ABOUT YOU**
**Essential**
* 4\+ years of experience in a design or studio management role, with demonstrable experience across both design production and traffic or workflow coordination.
* Solid design skills with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign. Able to produce and adapt creative work independently to a high standard.
* Proven experience managing studio traffic and creative project delivery in a fast\-paced agency environment.
* Strong organisational skills with a methodical approach to managing multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Experience overseeing artwork preparation and file management for print, digital, and large\-format production.
* Excellent communication skills \- clear, direct, and confident in working across creative, account, and client teams.
* A high standard of personal output combined with a genuine drive to maintain quality standards across the work of others.
* Experience working with or managing freelance designers, external suppliers, and production partners.
* Strong interest in the sports and entertainment industry.
* Experience in a sport, events, or entertainment marketing environment.


**Desirable**
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Monday.com, Asana, or equivalent studio management platforms.
* Motion graphics or video editing capability: After Effects, Premiere Pro.
* Experience working with government entities, rights holders, or major event organisers in the GCC region.
* Understanding of the UAE and wider Middle East market, including cultural sensitivities and regional production requirements.


**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means the creative and design delivery runs without drama. Briefs are clear, deadlines are met, quality is consistent, and the creative team has the space to do their best work because the operational infrastructure around them is solid.
   

  

 You are the person who knows where every job is at any given moment. You are across the detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. You care about the quality of the work as much as the efficiency of the process \- and you understand that one enables the other.
   

  

 You are proactive, not reactive. You spot a capacity issue before it becomes a crisis. You push back on a brief that is not ready. You maintain standards under pressure and bring the team with you when the pace picks up.
   

  

 You work comfortably across creative and operational worlds. You can sit in a briefing with a client director and a production call with a printer on the same day, and add value in both. You bring professionalism, consistency, and craft to everything that carries the agency's name.
   

  

 Built for pace and precision. Committed to quality at every stage. This role is suited to a highly organised, creatively capable Design Manager who wants to play a central role in one of the region's most active sport and entertainment agencies.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\. No recruiters please.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. It defines the way we work and the work we produce. We believe: It’s easier to complicate than simplify. Simple ideas enter the brain quicker and stay there longer. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.
   

  

 ABOUT M\+C SAATCHI GROUP
   

  

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. M\+C Saatchi Group’s work is informed by two core principles \- Brutal Simplicity of Thought and Diversity of Thought. Together they guide how problems are solved and integrated specialist teams are built. Headquartered in London, M\+C Saatchi Group have circa 2,500 employees globally. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 OUR AMBITION
   

  

 At M\+C Saatchi Group, our ambition is to create and curate Cultural Power for our clients. We do this by connecting specialist expertise, powered by creativity, data and technology, to help build famous brands and solve the most complex business and societal challenges.

* Ensure all project documentation \- briefs, schedules, sign\-off records — is accurate, complete, and properly filed.


**Client \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with the wider team and departments to manage workload, set realistic timelines, and ensure creative capacity is allocated effectively.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with internal teams on project status, flagging risks and changes as they arise.
* Support the Art Director and Senior Client Director in preparing and presenting work where required.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with external suppliers \- print partners, production studios, photographers, and video producers and build a strong database of contacts, suppliers and agency friends we can tap into.


**Creative Team Support**
* Support and coordinate junior members of the creative team, helping to manage their workload and develop their understanding of agency processes.
* Contribute actively to the studio's creative culture \- bringing energy, rigour, and a commitment to standards to everything you do.
* Stay current with design trends, production techniques, and tools relevant to sport, events, and brand marketing.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and play an active role in maintaining the quality of the agency's output across all accounts.


**Essential**
**ABOUT YOU**
* 4\+ years of experience in a design or studio management role, with demonstrable experience across both design production and traffic or workflow coordination.
* Solid design skills with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign. Able to produce and adapt creative work independently to a high standard.
* Proven experience managing studio traffic and creative project delivery in a fast\-paced agency environment.
* Strong organisational skills with a methodical approach to managing multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Experience overseeing artwork preparation and file management for print, digital, and large\-format production.
* Excellent communication skills \- clear, direct, and confident in working across creative, account, and client teams.
* A high standard of personal output combined with a genuine drive to maintain quality standards across the work of others.
* Experience working with or managing freelance designers, external suppliers, and production partners.
* Strong interest in the sports and entertainment industry.
* Experience in a sport, events, or entertainment marketing environment.


**Desirable**
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Monday.com, Asana, or equivalent studio management platforms.
* Motion graphics or video editing capability: After Effects, Premiere Pro.
* Experience working with government entities, rights holders, or major event organisers in the GCC region.
* Understanding of the UAE and wider Middle East market, including cultural sensitivities and regional production requirements.


**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means the creative and design delivery runs without drama. Briefs are clear, deadlines are met, quality is consistent, and the creative team has the space to do their best work because the operational infrastructure around them is solid.
   

  

 You are the person who knows where every job is at any given moment. You are across the detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. You care about the quality of the work as much as the efficiency of the process \- and you understand that one enables the other.
   

  

 You are proactive, not reactive. You spot a capacity issue before it becomes a crisis. You push back on a brief that is not ready. You maintain standards under pressure and bring the team with you when the pace picks up.
   

  

 You work comfortably across creative and operational worlds. You can sit in a briefing with a client director and a production call with a printer on the same day, and add value in both. You bring professionalism, consistency, and craft to everything that carries the agency's name.
   

  

 Built for pace and precision. Committed to quality at every stage. This role is suited to a highly organised, creatively capable Design Manager who wants to play a central role in one of the region's most active sport and entertainment agencies.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\. No recruiters please.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. It defines the way we work and the work we produce. We believe: It’s easier to complicate than simplify. Simple ideas enter the brain quicker and stay there longer. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.
   

  

 ABOUT M\+C SAATCHI GROUP
   

  

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. M\+C Saatchi Group’s work is informed by two core principles \- Brutal Simplicity of Thought and Diversity of Thought. Together they guide how problems are solved and integrated specialist teams are built. Headquartered in London, M\+C Saatchi Group have circa 2,500 employees globally. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 OUR AMBITION
   

  

 At M\+C Saatchi Group, our ambition is to create and curate Cultural Power for our clients. We do this by connecting specialist expertise, powered by creativity, data and technology, to help build famous brands and solve the most complex business and societal challenges.
   

  

**M\+C Saatchi Group** 
 was founded in 1995 and is now the biggest Independent creative agency group in the World. Founded on one core principle, Brutal Simplicity.
