data.jd_text:
We are looking for an
 **IT Project Manager** 
 to support the delivery of technology projects for our client, a large semi\-governmental organization in Dubai. This role requires a hands\-on project management professional who can support the Delivery Manager across multiple initiatives while independently managing smaller projects.
 



  





 This is an initial 12\-month contract role within the organization and reports to the Delivery Manager in the Technology department.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Support the Delivery Manager in planning, executing, and monitoring technology projects.
* Independently manage smaller projects from initiation to closure, ensuring delivery within scope, timeline, budget, and quality requirements.
* Maintain project plans, RAID logs, status reports, and other project documentation.
* Coordinate activities across business teams, technology teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure timely delivery.
* Prepare project dashboards, executive reports, and governance updates.
* Support PMO governance activities, including steering committee preparation, project reviews, and action tracking.
* Assist in establishing and enhancing PMO processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards.
* Monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests, escalating where required.
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings and ensure adherence to project methodologies and organizational policies.
* Support UAT, deployment planning, vendor coordination, and lessons learned activities.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience:** 



* 4–6 years of experience in IT project management, PMO, or project coordination roles within enterprise environments.
* Experience supporting large technology programmes while independently delivering smaller projects.
* Knowledge of PMO governance, project reporting, dashboarding, and executive status reporting.
* Understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Experience managing project artefacts including project plans, RAID logs, status reports, and action trackers.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as MS Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI, or similar platforms.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Exposure to PMO setup, governance frameworks, or continuous improvement initiatives is advantageous.
* Experience delivering enterprise applications, digital transformation, or technology\-enabled business projects is preferred.
* CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum, or equivalent certification is desirable.
* Experience within government, semi\-government, real estate, or large enterprise organizations would be advantageous.



  





**Availability:** 
 Preference will be given to candidates available immediately or a maximum of 30 days after accepting the offer.
 



  





 We are looking for a candidate who will be able to work in United Arab Emirates. Please apply with your resume and remember to provide us with your contact details.
 



  





 We will review your job application within 7 working days. Should your profile fit the requirements of the role, a consultant from Edari will be in touch with you to discuss the role in more detail and potential next steps.

data.jd_text:
**Responsibilities:** 



* Provide inputs to the development of the overall division strategy and participate in developing the business unit strategy in line with the vision, mission, and business objectives of the company.
* Deliver the Facilities Management strategy while ensuring contractual commitments are successfully met.
* Manage the effective achievement of the business unit’s objectives through leading the Facilities and Operations team in the assigned project, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance.
* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.
* Lead and manage the Facilities Management function while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all the unit activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed unit objectives.
* Discuss “Side\-Specific\-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible.
* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.
* Monitor service delivery performance and lead the evaluation of suppliers’ performance to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations (projects, civil works, mechanical works, electrical works, landscaping, building inspections, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to audio visual equipment, BMS, chillers, generators, HVAC, IT, etc.).
* Attend all coordination meetings with the tenants and contractors to discuss the progress of the fit out works and collect the required documentation, carry out an overall inspection after the completion of the fit out works, prepare the snag list to for the tenant, and follow up on all rectification works needed.
* Monitor the request for quotations and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays.
* Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted.
* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems).
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services the company provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation.
* Ensure the legionella reporting is timely sent to HSEEQ department.
* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department.
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented.
* Ensure availability of MS and RA



  





**Qualifications, Experiences, Skills**



* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable
* 10 – 12 years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management in hospitality projects.

 Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. data.jd_text:
Inhabit is a unique, multi\-disciplinary team of professionals who are passionate about making a positive contribution to our built environment.
   

  





 We are a collective of experienced architects, designers, engineers and detailers who work both independently and in partnership to form a holistic approach to the services that we offer. We believe that our respective areas of expertise can be integrated to allow seamless interdisciplinary synergy to create buildings that are more relevant to our evolving society.
   

  





 We are focused on design\-led engineering, providing technical and comprehensive solutions that thoughtfully and creatively consider aesthetics, engineering, cost, procurement, and sustainability driving towards a building that is sensitive and inspirational within its socio\-cultural context.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**List of Responsibilities**




 The Associate forms part of the engineering team within the global structure of the company and assumes general responsibilities that pro\-actively contribute to the growth of Façade engineering and deisgn capabilities across the globe.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for all design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken for Façade and all other disciplines. You may lead, develop, and manage a team of up to 5 direct reports. You may also need to fulfil any legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 The following is an overview of responsibilities and performance standards required of the Façade Designer:
   

  




* Strategic Management
* Financial Management
* Marketing and Business Development
* Staff Management, Mentoring and Training
* Client Management
* Project Management
* Consultancy Function
* Technical Excellence
* Personal Growth



**Strategic Management**




 The Associate will contribute to short and long\-term regional planning and assist in driving forward the strategy that embodies Inhabit’s values, vision, mission and objectives to successfully grow the business including:
   

  




* Assist in developing the regional business plan aligned to Inhabit strategic plan to be approved by the Regional Director. Assist in setting regional objectives and in preparing and implementing strategies to achieve the business plan. Ensure staff are well informed and up to date on developments that affect them
* Assist in undertaking regional future workforce planning and projects with an emphasis on growth and innovation.



**Financial Management**




 The Associate shall assist in the proper financial management including:
   

  




* Assist in the development and implementation of annual budgets and ensure that adequate internal control mechanisms are in place
* Monitor financial aspects of projects including monthly invoicing to ensure the accuracy and debtor collection
* Follow up with clients on overdue fees for debtors greater than 90 days
* Assist in reviewing and monitoring monthly financial reports
* Assisting in managing business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to signing (and following award of) any consulting commission



**Marketing and Business Development**




 The Associate shall actively participate in the marketing of the practice as a multi\-disciplined engineering company and shall achieve agreed targets in all aspects of practice development, including:
   

  




* Maximise cross\-selling opportunities for Inhabit and prepare project proposals to support profit targets including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Raise any challenges in competitive pricing across the region with the Regional Manager and propose solutions
* Build and expand the client base of Inhabit based on both established, prospective and new client relationships that you secure in the region
* Network within the Industry to develop industry intelligence, define and implement strategies to meet any challenges
* Ensure active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions, networking events, conferences, seminars, committees etc. to enhance the professional image of both the Associate and Inhabit



**Staff Management, Mentoring and Training**




 The Associate is responsible for ensuring staff are managed and supported effectively including:
   

  




* Encourage and role model respectful, supportive and positive engagement and interactions across disciplines/support functions and all other Inhabit offices to support positive culture and drive engagement
* Identify the deliverables, tasks and activities required for workload throughout all phases of the project to ensure adequate staff resourcing and tools are available to meet project deliverables and expectations
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, mentoring and support and build and oversee staff technical development to maintain standards and to operate efficiently
* Ensure staff are following Inhabit’s quality management system
* Hold regular meetings with the Technical Team to discuss scheduling of work in a planned manner including distribution of workload, resources etc. to meet deliverables
* Assist in setting objectives and standards for the expected performance of staff and encourage regular feedback discussions on project successes and challenges to capture lessons learned
* Assist in conducting regular and effective Performance Reviews in accordance within Inhabits’ review system for your direct reports and provide ongoing/regular feedback to foster work performance improvements and promote professional growth of staff
* Identify training needs of the team to increase their skill level, development and growth
* Identify training opportunities, both internally and externally including seminars, events, conferences, talks, university lectures, factory visits, construction phase training etc., to assist with the development of the team and to address any knowledge and skill gaps. Support staff writing technical notes from these training opportunities and/or project experiences
* Encourage and promote Inhabit online materials, technical notes, technical library
* Communicate regularly and proactively with Senior Management as required to assist the process of managing your work/lifestyle balance and of your team
* Ensure staff adhere to and are familiar with all Health and Safety requirements and safe work practices



**Client Management**




 The Associate shall continually strengthen client loyalty and gain repeat business by ensuring high\-quality service and creative (‘Leading Edge’) solutions to clients by way of:
   

  




* Communicate with clients to establish their needs and maintain a dialogue throughout the project
* Monitor feedback from clients and develop and implement action plans for continuous improvement
* Identify and implement ways to enhance current service offerings, systems and processes from a client and business perspective to maximise Inhabit’s competitive advantage
* Identify and implement ways to enhance internal systems, processes and procedures to improve client satisfaction
* Be a role model for exceptional favourable record in client response to timeliness, quality of work and high technical standing on projects and manage in conjunction with Project Director/Leader any client complaints
* Continually aim for repeat and new business from all clients in contact with Inhabit



**Project Management**




 The Associate will provide leadership to ensure the efficient and profitable completion of all tasks and projects under their control whilst ensuring the allocation of adequate resources, excellent technical standards and client satisfaction including:
   

  




* Provide overall strategy and technical solutions as required for project challenges
* Undertake or assist the project leaders with negotiation of fees and contracts where appropriate to ensure financial targets are achieved
* Manage business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to the signing contracts
* Allocate and manage project personnel to suit programs and project budgets
* Project lead internally with respective team colleagues to allow deliverables to be issued to client
* Coordinate and work with the design team to deliver project deliverables
* Help solve client/project team’s problems by lateral thinking and creating innovative solutions
* Ensure quality outputs and agreed cost/scheduled delivery time frames are met
* Manage projects, site meetings, design workshops and site inspection as required and/or as project planning stipulates
* As Project Leader, monitor and report on team performance against agreed timelines, and fees/budgets
* Oversee the work of Sub Consultants/Contractors and review outputs produced by them
* Ensure project sheets for each project are undertaken for compliance with project and office QA procedures



**Consultancy Function**




 The Associate shall assist in the consultancy functions including:
   

  




* Preparation and coordination of expressions of interest, tender submissions and similar consulting proposals
* Maintain a hands\-on approach to the provision of design and engineering, and assist in the co\-ordination of other disciplines.
* Contribute and monitor the design and engineering of curtain wall and cladding systems, as well as specialty systems (i.e., structural glass, cables, ETFE etc.)
* Oversee engineering computations and structural façade analysis, advice and reporting
* Meet with architects to develop façade design concepts, detailing, specifications, and engineering feasibility and coordinate with other project consultants such as Builders, Contractors and Sub Contractors to determine best practice façade design outcomes
* Write and review specifications and schedules to inform and respond to site and construction related queries
* Review and comment on sub\-contractor’s shop drawings \& calculations, BD submission drawings, fabrication drawings \& material submission
* Follow the general drawing protocols and cad file system set by Inhabit
* Provide assistance during construction of façade systems including attendance mock\-up testing, shop drawing reviews and conduct factory \& site inspections



**Technical Excellence**




 The Associate shall assume full responsibility for work quality undertaken and ensure quality is adhered to by performing regular checks of your direct reports work and a senior peer review role on projects, including:
   

  




* Ensure project specific technical duties including engineering, design and project lead roles are effectively managed
* Identification of technically complex projects and problems that require high level input
* Undertake provision of concept design, peer review and checking services on projects to assist in maintaining high standards
* Provide technical assistance and grow the team’s capability relating to the weatherproofing and installation of various façade systems
* Assist in developing and growing the BIM capability of the office in conjunction with other team members, aligning Inhabit’s capabilities with market expectations\\
* Take necessary action to prevent the occurrence of design documentation and/or quality system non\-conformity
* Ensure all project documentation is maintained to a level as required by Inhabits’ QA Manager and QA system
* Endorse and facilitate the quality management system (QMS) and the Business’s commitment to quality
* Conduct all activities in accordance with the quality management system



**Personal Attributes:**



* Attitude and participation towards project, client, team
* Motivation in role
* Sense of urgency when appropriate
* Confidence in role amongst team and clients
* Desire to achieve high standards, set goals or targets
* Overall commitment to your position
* Adaptability and willingness to learn
* How you apply new skills
* Team interaction
* Willingness to help others



**Role Capability Profile**




**Quality \& Quantity of Work:**



* Assures accuracy, thoroughness and reliability of results
* Meets the workload requirements of the job
* Is proficient in technical skills required for the job
* Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of the knowledge required to complete job responsibilities



**Decisions:**



* Conducts thorough analysis before making decisions
* Makes sound, logical and timely decisions



**Planning \& Time Management:**



* Develops \& implements effective action plans
* Meets deadlines as required
* Maintains performance under pressure
* Timesheet efficiency (weekly submission)



**Performance Management:**



* Achieves own objectives
* Delegates appropriate tasks to appropriate people
* Gives employees adequate information \& authority
* Follows up progress on delegated projects
* Provides ongoing feedback and training to employees where relevant

data.jd_text:
WW\+P is a world\-leading architecture, urban design, and planning practice with more than 400 architects, urban designers, and planners across 12 studios worldwide, including offices in London and Manchester. Founded in 1985, the practice integrates planning, urban design, landscape architecture, and architecture to deliver projects that combine visionary regenerative design thinking with technical excellence. Our work spans scales and disciplines to create better cities, smarter infrastructure, and more inclusive communities.
   

  





 WW\+P is also a member of the 10N Collective, a group of leading urbanism, architecture, and design practices brought together by Egis. In 2026, SvN Architects and Planners merged with WW\+P, bringing together more than 80 years of combined expertise in transformative urban design and planning.
   

  





 As part of the Egis Group, a global leader in architecture, consulting, engineering, construction, and mobility services, WW\+P contributes to shaping sustainable, resilient, and climate\-responsive environments worldwide. Operating in 100 countries with 19,500 employees, Egis delivers innovative solutions that support balanced territorial development and improve quality of life for communities around the globe.
   

  





 In the Middle East, Egis employs 3,500 professionals across eight countries and has successfully delivered more than 700 complex development projects. Recognised among the region's leading engineering and consulting firms, Egis combines global expertise with deep local knowledge to support governments, investors, and developers in delivering sustainable growth and lasting positive impact.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**
* Represent WW\+P in the region, utilising a comprehensive knowledge of the WW\+P project portfolio, values, and approach.
* Collaborate with the WW\+P global studio, primarily through liaison with the Middle East Managing Director and Senior Leadership Team.
* Collaborate with the 10N Collective to maximise working synergies and support regional growth.
* Collaborate with all relevant Egis Business Lines and Units to maximise working synergies and support growth. Close working relationships with relevant colleagues in Transportation, Energy \& Sustainable Cites, and Aviation will be important to the success of the role.
* Support the management of design teams based in the WW\+P global studios, in the role of local first\-point\-of\-contact for clients and partners.
* Build key client relationships through increased exposure and networking and establish business opportunity within this.
* Be a champion of a user\-centric design philosophy, demonstrating empathy with end\-users and creating projects that resonate with their needs and desires.
* Safeguard and evolve the identity of WW\+P, ensuring output aligns with the brand's values and messaging.
* Support and mine new business opportunities: advance the client’s knowledge of core capabilities; recognize untapped opportunities within existing relationships; leverage formal and informal networks in the pursuit of new business possibilities.
* Maximise project profit returns where possible.


**Qualifications**
* Proven track record of delivering excellent, award\-winning design on a variety of project typologies.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate and present design concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Knowledge of the Middle East construction market, including the relevant local and international clients, consultants, contractors and stakeholders.
* Leadership experience including the ability to communicate with and manage remote design teams.
* Strong commercial understanding and project management.
* Exceptional portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and successful implementations.

data.jd_text:
Join Our Team at Eaton: Empowering Tomorrow, Today!
   

  

 Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for
 **Global Program engineer Manager \- Multi‑Tenant Data Centers (MTDC).** 
 The role is a globally focused leadership role within the Post‑Order CoE, accountable for driving consistent execution, operational alignment, and customer outcomes across Eaton’s largest MTDC customers. This role ensures that Eaton delivers as One Eaton for multi\-tenant customers by coordinating post‑order activities across regions, business units, and functions. The position is based in Dubai and operates with global responsibility across EMEA, Americas, and APAC.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Strategic Account Operations Leadership**
* Act as the global post‑order CoE operational lead for assigned MTDC strategic accounts.
* Ensure Eaton delivers as One Global Organization, with consistent execution models and customer experience worldwide
* Serve as the primary operations interface between Eaton and MTDC customers following contract award.
* Ensure alignment between commercial commitments and execution capabilities across regions.


**Global Execution Governance**
* Drive adoption of standardized global execution models, operating rhythms, and governance frameworks for MTDC customers.
* Lead cross‑regional operating reviews focused on schedule, quality, risk, cost, and customer satisfaction.
* Establish performance visibility through dashboards, metrics, and structured reporting.


**Risk Management \& Issue Resolution**
* Proactively identify delivery, capacity, quality, and schedule risks across global deployments.
* Lead structured mitigation plans and escalations in partnership with regional and functional leaders.
* Ensure rapid issue resolution while maintaining strong customer confidence and trust.


**Cross**

* Support alignment between Global Account Management, regional sales teams, and post‑order execution.


**Continuous Improvement \& Scalability**
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives to enhance execution efficiency, predictability, and scalability for MTDC programs.
* Capture lessons learned and deployed best practices across regions and accounts.
* Support digitalization and process maturity initiatives aligned with Eaton Business System (EBS) principles.

**Why Join Eaton**

* Your wellbeing matters – Health, safety, and wellness are a priority. At Eaton, wellbeing goes beyond programs, empowering employees with the tools and environment to thrive.

 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.
   

  

 All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

**Description**
 At Kempinski, we don't just offer stays; we curate moments. As a hospitality organization, anchored in a legacy of elegance and a pioneering spirit, we have grown into a collection of iconic hotels and resorts around the world, each a landmark in its own right. From grand palaces steeped in history to contemporary masterpieces of design, Kempinski is where impeccable service meets authentic local experiences.
   

  

 We empower our people to be artisans of hospitality, fostering an environment where passion is nurtured, individuality is celebrated, and every detail is thoughtfully considered. Joining Kempinski means becoming part of a family that is dedicated to creating memories that last a lifetime for our guests, and a fulfilling and enriching career for our team.
   

  

 If you are driven by excellence, inspired by the art of hospitality, and seek to contribute to a legacy of luxury, we invite you to explore the exceptional opportunities that await you at Kempinski Hotels. Come, be a part of our story.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The SVP Technology is responsible for shaping and delivering a world\-class technology ecosystem that enhances ultra\-luxury guest experience, operational excellence, and brand differentiation across the Group’s global portfolio.
   

  

 As a key member of the extended Executive leadership team, the role drives the modernization and transformation of the Technology function, positioning it as a strategic enabler of performance, personalization, and scalable growth:
   

  

**Luxury Guest Experience Enablement** 
* Elevate the end\-to\-end digital guest journey across properties.
* Ensure seamless integration between PMS, CRM, Revenue, POS, and guest\-facing platforms.
* Enable data\-driven personalization and service excellence aligned with luxury brand standards.
* Support innovation in guest engagement, mobile services, and experiential technologies.


**Global Technology Strategy** 
* Define and execute a forward\-looking technology roadmap aligned with brand and ownership expectations.
* Align corporate and property technology standards globally.
* Lead investment governance and value realization across all initiatives.


**Infrastructure \& Applications Leadership** 
* Modernize infrastructure across corporate \& hotel environments (cloud\-first, resilient architecture).
* Oversee core enterprise and hospitality systems.
* Standardize and simplify the global application landscape while preserving property level flexibility.

data.jd_text:
**Confidential Opportunity – Head of Risk (UAE Regulated Financial Services)** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced Head of Risk to join a growing regulated financial services organization in the UAE.
 



  





 This is a unique opportunity for a risk leader who enjoys building, shaping, and scaling risk functions within a fast\-paced environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall risk management framework of the business while remaining closely involved in the operational execution of risk management activities.
 



 The role is subject to regulatory approval and fit\-and\-proper assessment by the relevant UAE regulatory authority. The successful candidate will serve as the designated Head of Risk and principal risk management officer for the organization
 



  





 Unlike larger financial institutions with extensive risk departments, this position requires a balance of strategic leadership and hands\-on execution. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating at Board and regulator level while also driving the day\-to\-day development and enhancement of the risk function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and continuously enhance the Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERM)
* Develop and maintain risk governance structures, policies, and reporting frameworks
* Establish and monitor risk appetite statements, risk registers, and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)
* Lead enterprise\-wide risk assessments across operational, regulatory, technology, strategic, and emerging risks
* Prepare and present risk reporting to Executive Committees, Risk Committees, and Board\-level forums
* Act as the primary risk management contact for regulatory engagement and supervisory reviews
* Provide effective challenge and risk oversight across business functions
* Build and develop the Risk function in line with the organization's growth trajectory
* Support the development of a strong risk culture across the organization



  





**Required Experience** 



* 8\-15 years of progressive risk management experience within regulated financial services
* Experience leading or owning an Enterprise Risk Management Framework
* Strong understanding of risk governance, risk appetite, risk assessments, and Board reporting
* Experience within fintech, payments, banking, EMI, acquiring, issuing, lending, or other regulated financial services environments
* Demonstrated experience engaging with regulators, executive management, and governance committees
* Ability to operate effectively in a growth\-stage environment where strategic and operational responsibilities coexist



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 You will be a strong match if you have:
 


* Previously held a Head of Risk, Risk Director, Senior Risk Manager, or equivalent position within a regulated financial services environment
* Experience building or enhancing risk frameworks rather than simply maintaining mature structures
* The credibility and capability to satisfy regulatory fit\-and\-proper requirements for a Head of Risk appointment
* A pragmatic and commercial approach to risk management
* The willingness to remain involved in operational delivery while leading the strategic direction of the function


- 


**Please Note** 




 This role is best suited to candidates who enjoy combining strategic leadership with hands\-on execution. Individuals whose experience is limited to highly specialized risk functions within large organizations, or whose background is primarily audit, compliance advisory, assurance, or consulting without direct ownership of enterprise risk management, may find the scope and nature of this position less aligned to their experience.
 



 All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence

Job Purpose:
 



 Lead complex assurance and advisory engagements at Dubai Health, emphasizing healthcare\-specific risks, regulatory compliance and strategic risk management. Provide expert insights to shape departmental audit planning and strategy, including annual risk assessments and innovative methodologies. Mentor audit team members and develop strategies to enhance governance, operational efficiency, and compliance in healthcare settings. Guide staff on best practices in healthcare auditing, advanced risk identification, data analytics, and emerging industry trends.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 



1. Lead and manage high\-complexity assurance and advisory assignments, delivering expert risk insights to inform and refine the department’s annual assurance planning and strategic priorities.
2. Collaborate with the Section Head and Director to conduct enterprise\-wide risk assessments, develop risk\-based audit strategies, and prioritize audit coverage.
3. Independently oversee audit fieldwork execution, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives, quality standards and timely delivery while mentoring team members on advanced techniques.
4. Design, implement and continuously refine internal audit policies, procedures and methodologies, incorporating innovative tools like AI\-driven analytics to support long\-term audit function strategy and resource optimization.
5. Analyze audit findings, trends and key performance indicators to identify systemic risks, recommend enhancements to clinical documentation, risk mitigation frameworks and overall governance structures.
6. Develop and deliver targeted training programs for audit staff, cross\-functional teams and stakeholders on compliance standards, healthcare audit best practices and strategic risk management.
7. Coordinate with external auditors, regulatory bodies and senior leadership to address audit findings, influence policy changes and contribute to organizational compliance strategies.
8. Evaluate and test controls through data collection, validation and analysis to assess risk exposure and control effectiveness, identifying opportunities for business process improvements.
9. Determine and apply optimal audit approaches, techniques and procedures to form objective opinions on control environments and strategic alignment.
10. Present comprehensive findings, recommendations and strategic insights to senior management, influencing decision\-making and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
11. Partner with business, IT and clinical stakeholders to co\-develop practical, sustainable actions that mitigate identified risks and align with Dubai Health’s strategic goals.
12. Draft detailed audit reports, track management responses and verify implementation of agreed actions to ensure accountability and strategic outcomes.
13. Contribute to periodic monitoring of Dubai Health’s risk profile, advising on emerging healthcare risks (e.g., cybersecurity in patient data, supply chain disruptions) to shape future audit strategies.
14. Promote 'smarter' assurance practices, such as predictive analytics and automation, to enhance audit efficiency and strategic value.
15. Maintain thorough documentation of audit work in line with IIA standards and departmental protocols, supporting knowledge sharing and strategic reviews.
16. Coach, mentor, and guide Internal Audit staff (including Seniors and Associates) on industry\-leading practices, risk identification, data analytics, and strategic thinking in healthcare auditing.



  





**Qualification Requirements:** 




 Bachelor \- Accounting or a related field
 



 Certification \- Chartered Accountant / CPA / CIA (Exception for UAE national)
 



  





**Years of Experience:** 




 8 (Exception for UAE National) \- Auditing / risk management or equivalent exposure in jobs involving process reviews and reviews of management information in Finance / other departments
 



 2\-3 (Exception for UAE National) \- Healthcare sector

Are you ready to lead a busy Operations Control Centre that coordinates operational safety, efficiency and resilience across our network? At
 **SolitAir** 
 , we’re seeking an experienced and adaptable leader to establish and head the Integrated Operations Control Centre (IOCC). This role will set the strategy, build the team, and oversee integrated operational control functions that ensure safe, compliant and on\-time service delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
 As Head of IOCC, you will:
   

  

* Establish and operationally manage the IOCC, including staffing, processes, tools and performance metrics to deliver 24/7 operational control.
* Lead cross\-functional coordination between flight operations, maintenance control, ground operations, cargo planning, safety, and regulatory liaison to resolve disruptions and maintain continuity.
* Drive problem solving for complex operational events by applying structured analysis, root cause identification, and timely corrective actions to minimise impact on safety and schedule.
* Develop flexible operating procedures and escalation frameworks to respond to dynamic operational conditions, including irregular operations, AOG events and severe weather.
* Implement and maintain integrated systems and dashboards that provide real\-time situational awareness and decision support for IOCC staff and senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, capturing lessons learned, training requirements and process enhancements to reduce recurrence of operational disruptions.
* Ensure all IOCC activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements and company policies, and coordinate timely reporting to regulators and stakeholders as required.
* Provide clear, effective communication in English across internal teams and external partners during normal and contingency operations.


****What We’re Looking For****
* Experience: Proven background in airline or aviation operational control roles, with significant experience leading operational teams and managing irregular operations.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical capability and structured problem solving skills, able to lead investigations, define root causes and implement robust corrective actions.
* Flexibility: Demonstrated adaptability to changing priorities and operational pressures; comfortable leading a 24/7 function with variable hours and rapid decision\-making demands. This means you are likely to work over weekends and/or evenings as operational demands require.
* English: Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear reports, brief senior leadership and communicate effectively across diverse teams.
* Leadership \& Communication: Strong people leadership skills, able to recruit, develop and motivate a high\-performing, inclusive team; confident at stakeholder engagement and crisis communication.
* Systems \& Data: Comfortable with operational control systems, real\-time dashboards and data\-driven decision making; experience with industry tools is desirable.
* Qualifications: Relevant degree or professional qualifications in aviation, operations management or related field preferred.


 At SolitAir, every role contributes to shaping the future of cargo aviation. We welcome applicants who bring practical experience, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to operational excellence. This is a gender neutral role and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for all candidates.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* An inclusive workplace with opportunities for professional growth and development.
* The chance to build and lead a new, and growing, high\-impact operational function at the heart of our business.
* A role that offers visibility and cross functional problem solving \- at SolitAir you'll be able to see the difference you make to the success of our business


 If you are an experienced operational leader with strong problem solving skills, flexibility and excellent English communication, we encourage you to apply and help shape SolitAir’s operational future.

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**Background and Context**
 Digital \& Technology sits at the heart of Haleon’s ambition to Win as One. We are Haleon’s digital backbone – how we accelerate impact, unlock new value, and build a future‑ready organisation. Digital isn’t simply part of our business; it is how we operate, grow, and deliver everyday health at scale.
   

  

 The Digital \& Technology function plays a critical role as a strategic partner to the business, turning insights into impact and ideas into innovation. From secure, resilient operations and modern digital foundations, to hyper‑personalised customer and consumer experiences, digital is embedded across every part of Haleon – shaping how we innovate, supply consumer demand, go to market, and run our internal operations.
   

  

 Our focus is clear: to secure the business, run resilient and compliant operations, and transform Haleon into a digital organisation that is wired for excellence. This is enabled by sustained investment in a scalable, resilient technology foundation and the adoption of digital solutions that empower our people, elevate performance, and enable the 4–6% organic revenue growth and productivity savings underpinning Win as One.
   

  

 Digital only delivers when people are at the centre. Building skills, confidence, and modern ways of working is essential to realising value from technology. Together, we are reshaping the backbone of Haleon to become a best‑in‑class consumer health company – bold, resilient, performance‑focused, and fit for the future.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
* Lead and manage high\-complexity assurance and advisory assignments, delivering expert risk insights to inform and refine the department’s annual assurance planning and strategic priorities.
* Collaborate with the Section Head and Director to conduct enterprise\-wide risk assessments, develop risk\-based audit strategies, and prioritize audit coverage.
* Independently oversee audit fieldwork execution, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives, quality standards and timely delivery while mentoring team members on advanced techniques.
* Design, implement and continuously refine internal audit policies, procedures and methodologies, incorporating innovative tools like AI\-driven analytics to support long\-term audit function strategy and resource optimization.
* Analyze audit findings, trends and key performance indicators to identify systemic risks, recommend enhancements to clinical documentation, risk mitigation frameworks and overall governance structures.
* Develop and deliver targeted training programs for audit staff, cross\-functional teams and stakeholders on compliance standards, healthcare audit best practices and strategic risk management.
* Coordinate with external auditors, regulatory bodies and senior leadership to address audit findings, influence policy changes and contribute to organizational compliance strategies.
* Evaluate and test controls through data collection, validation and analysis to assess risk exposure and control effectiveness, identifying opportunities for business process improvements.
* Determine and apply optimal audit approaches, techniques and procedures to form objective opinions on control environments and strategic alignment.
* Present comprehensive findings, recommendations and strategic insights to senior management, influencing decision\-making and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
* Partner with business, IT and clinical stakeholders to co\-develop practical, sustainable actions that mitigate identified risks and align with Dubai Health’s strategic goals.
* Draft detailed audit reports, track management responses and verify implementation of agreed actions to ensure accountability and strategic outcomes.
* Contribute to periodic monitoring of Dubai Health’s risk profile, advising on emerging healthcare risks (e.g., cybersecurity in patient data, supply chain disruptions) to shape future audit strategies.
* Promote 'smarter' assurance practices, such as predictive analytics and automation, to enhance audit efficiency and strategic value.
* Maintain thorough documentation of audit work in line with IIA standards and departmental protocols, supporting knowledge sharing and strategic reviews.
* Coach, mentor, and guide Internal Audit staff (including Seniors and Associates) on industry\-leading practices, risk identification, data analytics, and strategic thinking in healthcare auditing.

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a senior technology leader to scale and expand our financial technology platform as the company expands across markets, products, partners, and regions.
 



  





 This role is suited for someone who can operate both strategically and hands\-on when needed, but whose main strength is building systems, teams, ownership models, and engineering discipline that do not depend on a single individual.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own technology strategy, architecture, engineering delivery, and platform operations.
* Ensure high availability, resilience, observability, and incident readiness across critical systems.
* Support the company’s cybersecurity posture across ISIEM, SOC, DLP, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, penetration testing, threat modelling, monitoring, incident response, and security awareness.
* Lead the practical adoption of Agentic AI across engineering and technology operations.
* Strengthen security, compliance, audit readiness, access controls, data protection, and secure SDLC practices.
* Build and mature NOC/SOC capabilities, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, escalation, and post\-incident reviews.
* Scale the platform and the technical team for geographical expansion, including multi\-market readiness, localisation needs, regulatory expectations, and infrastructure scalability.
* Manage technical relationships with third\-party providers of core services, including issuing processors, payment providers, banking partners, cloud vendors, security vendors, and integration platforms.
* Improve ownership models, documentation, Runbooks, SLAs, and operational accountability.
* Partner with Product, Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and executive leadership.
* Reduce key\-person dependency and help build a reliable leadership structure across engineering and operations.



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* 10\+ years Senior technology leadership experience in a roles VP Engineering/ Technology, Head of Engineering/Technology, or similar.
* Experience in fintech, specifically issuing, acquiring or banking is essential.
* Proven track record scaling reliable, secure, compliant production systems.
* Proven track record of the Agentic AI adaptation and productivity gain.
* Experience building engineering teams, technical operations, NOC/SOC processes, and delivery discipline.
* Experience with either ISO27001, SAMA, SOC2 and PCI DSS regulatory implementation and support.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, backend platforms, APIs, data systems, observability, disaster recovery and incident management.
* Experience working with third\-party providers of mission\-critical services.
* Ability to operate across strategy, architecture, execution, people leadership, and executive communication.

data.jd_text:
KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end\-to\-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.
 



  





 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented Cloud and Infrastructure Platforms Director to to join our award\-winning team based in Dubai, UAE.
 



  





 This critical leadership role is responsible for defining, delivering, and managing the organization’s enterprise cloud, infrastructure, and platform strategy across regional and international operations. The successful candidate will lead the modernization of IT infrastructure, cloud adoption, cybersecurity resilience, digital workplace technologies, and enterprise platform services to support a rapidly growing construction consultancy business.
 



  





 The role requires a highly experienced technology leader with a strong background in hybrid cloud environments, enterprise infrastructure operations, IT governance, cybersecurity, and large\-scale transformation initiatives within complex, multi\-site organizations.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;
 



  





**Strategic \& Platform Leadership** 




  




* Define and execute KEO's cloud\-first, platform\-first infrastructure strategy, leading the evolution from traditional operations toward a modern platform engineering model that enables self\-service, automated, and product\-oriented infrastructure capabilities.
* Manage and continuously improve service reliability at enterprise scale, owning KEO's infrastructure performance and availability posture in alignment with digital transformation goals and business priorities.



  





**Cloud \& Platform Engineering** 




  




* Own and evolve KEO's Microsoft Azure environment, leading the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms through cloud\-native architectures, infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC), and platform engineering principles to ensure scalability, security, cost\-optimization, and developer agility.
* Oversee identity and access management via Microsoft Entra ID, enforcing MFA, RBAC, and least\-privilege principles, and manage KEO's zero\-trust network architecture ensuring access is granted only through verified identity, context, and policy.
* Maintain certified digital platforms \- including Microsoft SharePoint and Autodesk Construction Cloud \- to their respective security and governance standards.
* Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives \- including right\-sizing, reserved capacity management, and workload scheduling \- to maximize return on cloud investment.



  





**Cybersecurity \& Digital Trust** 




  




* Champion KEO's cybersecurity posture across all infrastructure and platform operations, overseeing Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM) for real\-time threat detection, automated response playbooks, and rapid incident management, alongside cloud security posture management (CSPM) for continuous assessment and remediation of misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.
* Ensure zero\-trust, least\-privilege, and access control governance principles are consistently applied and independently verified via EY audits, and lead KEO's phishing simulation programme to drive continuous improvements in security awareness.
* Maintain and continuously improve Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) programmes \- including automation of recovery workflows, regular testing, and audit\-readiness \- with appropriate escalation to IT leadership and executive oversight.



  





**Modern Service Management** 




  




* Lead a shift from traditional ITIL\-process orientation toward experience\-driven, outcome\-based service management, owning service reliability engineering practices including SLAs, SLOs, and error budgets across all platforms.
* Lead continuous service improvement cycles, platform lifecycle governance, and technology refresh programmes, ensuring all operations adhere to KEO's IT governance standards, security policies, regulatory requirements, and green IT sustainability commitments.



  





**Automation, DevOps \& SRE Mindset** 




  




* Champion an automation\-first culture, leading the implementation of infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipeline integration, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations to eliminate manual processes at scale.
* Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles \- including error budgets, reliability targets, and blameless post\-incident reviews \- to drive continuous improvement in platform deployment velocity, reliability, and recovery time.



  





**Data\-Driven \& AI\-Enabled Operations** 




  




* Lead the adoption of observability platforms and AIOps tooling to enable predictive performance monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated incident response, driving responsible AI adoption to enhance infrastructure efficiency, intelligent capacity planning, and proactive operations
* Use operational telemetry and data\-driven insights to inform platform investment decisions and continuous improvement initiatives, staying at the forefront of AI\-driven infrastructure operations and edge computing to evaluate and recommend adoption pathways aligned to KEO's strategy.



  





**Team Leadership \& People Development** 




  




* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing, geographically distributed infrastructure team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and champion professional growth and certification of each team member.
* Build a psychologically safe team environment where automation innovation, constructive challenge, and knowledge sharing are actively encouraged.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with Digital Workplace, Enterprise Digital Solutions, and Technology Strategy teams to ensure “one IT” delivery



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, including a minimum of 3–5 years in a leadership capacity managing teams, cloud platforms, or enterprise infrastructure operations. You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or possess an equivalent combination of education and over 10 years of relevant professional experience.
 



  




* Proven, hands\-on experience managing Microsoft Azure cloud environments at enterprise scale, including hybrid cloud architecture, identity, and security services.
* Demonstrated experience leading a shift from traditional infrastructure management to modern platform engineering and DevOps\-aligned operations.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD for infrastructure, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations.
* Experience applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including error budgets, SLOs, and blameless post\-incident review practices.
* Proven cloud financial management (FinOps) experience: cost optimization, chargeback models, consumption governance, and cloud cost dashboards.
* Deep expertise in cybersecurity operations: Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM), zero\-trust architecture, cloud security posture management (CSPM), Entra ID / Azure AD, and endpoint security.
* Experience managing third\-party governance and audit review processes.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven infrastructure operations, edge computing architectures, and platform product models.
* Experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or professional services sector is advantageous.
* Understanding of sustainable/green IT infrastructure principles and their application to cloud operations.



  





 KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.
 



  





 We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award\-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.

* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.

* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)

* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.

**Skills Required:**

* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.

**What you will get in return:**

* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.

**Overview**
 This global portfolio operations team is seeking an experienced Executive Director to play a key leadership role within a rapidly growing investment platform. The successful candidate will be responsible for originating, evaluating, executing, and managing investments across multiple asset classes while contributing to portfolio strategy, capital allocation decisions, and overall business growth.
   

  

 Working closely with senior leadership, the Executive Director will lead transaction execution, manage stakeholder relationships, mentor investment professionals, and help shape the long\-term investment strategy of the platform.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Investment Strategy \& Portfolio Management**
* Support the development and execution of investment strategy across targeted sectors, geographies, and asset classes
* Identify investment themes, market trends, and emerging opportunities aligned with strategic objectives
* Provide recommendations on capital allocation, portfolio construction, and risk management
* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend value creation initiatives


**Deal Origination \& Execution**
* Source and originate investment opportunities through established industry networks and strategic relationships
* Lead all stages of the investment process, including opportunity assessment, financial analysis, valuation, structuring, due diligence, negotiations, and execution
* Prepare investment memoranda and present recommendations to senior management and investment committees
* Coordinate with legal, tax, technical, commercial, and financial advisors throughout transaction processes


**Asset Management \& Value Creation**
* Work closely with portfolio companies, operating partners, and management teams to drive performance improvement and strategic initiatives
* Support business transformation, operational optimisation, growth strategies, and capital planning across investments
* Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators and report on portfolio developments


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, financial institutions, advisors, developers, operators, and strategic partners
* Represent the organisation in negotiations, industry events, and key stakeholder meetings
* Mentor and develop junior investment professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with finance, legal, risk, treasury, and business leadership teams


**Governance \& Risk Management**
* Ensure all investments adhere to internal governance frameworks, investment policies, and risk management standards
* Present investment opportunities and portfolio updates to governance committees and senior leadership
* Maintain high standards of compliance, transparency, and fiduciary responsibility


**Skills \& Experience**
**Essential Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Real Estate, or related discipline
* 12\-18\+ years of relevant experience in private equity, sovereign wealth funds, investment management, principal investing, infrastructure, real estate, private credit, or investment banking
* Demonstrated track record of leading complex transactions from origination through execution
* Strong financial modelling, valuation, due diligence, and investment analysis capabilities
* Experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting to investment committees and boards
* Excellent commercial judgement and strategic thinking skills
* Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing and developing teams
* Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA, CFA, CAIA, or other relevant postgraduate qualification
* Experience investing across real estate, infrastructure, private equity, credit, or alternative investments
* Exposure to large\-scale investment platforms and institutional capital deployment
* Experience operating in international markets with strong understanding of regional investment dynamics
* Proven ability to manage multiple transactions and priorities in a fast\-paced environment


 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

 This position offers the opportunity to shape investment strategy and drive value creation across multiple asset classes within a rapidly growing platform. The role provides significant exposure to senior leadership, complex transaction execution, and the chance to mentor and develop investment professionals while contributing to long\-term strategic objectives.

 Senna is a careers platform for professionals pursuing opportunities in private equity. The platform brings together relevant roles, market context, and hiring signals to help candidates navigate the market with greater clarity. For more information, visit joinsenna.com.
